Mission & Core Values 

Yucatán Beach and City Properties is committed to delivering transparent, legally sound, and client‑focused real estate services throughout Mérida and the Yucatán coast. [Get to know Us](https://yucatanbeachandcityproperties.com/about-us)

Yucatán Beach and City Properties is a full‑service real estate brokerage serving Mérida and the Yucatán coast.

For us, “full‑service” means guiding clients through the entire real estate process with professionalism, clear communication, and a strong understanding of how transactions are conducted in this region.

We support both buyers and sellers with accurate information, careful documentation, and a commitment to maintaining high standards in marketing, client service, and transaction coordination.

Our team works closely with closing attorneys, Notarios, and all parties involved to help ensure each step moves forward in an organized and transparent manner.

Our focus is on providing a well‑guided, well‑supported experience that reflects our values and the trust our clients place in us.

Buy With Confidence
===================

**Find your place in Mérida and surrounding areas, including the Gulf Coast beaches — with clarity and confidence.** 

 Our team guides you through every step of the buying process with transparent information, trusted local expertise, and personalized support — so you can focus on choosing the home that feels right for you.

Our Approach
------------

Whether you are a local buyer or a foreigner new to purchasing property in Yucatán, the process has its own structure and requirements.

We take a structured, detail‑driven approach to help you understand each step clearly from the beginning.

Our goal is to provide accurate information, realistic expectations, and steady guidance so you can make informed decisions with confidence.

[Get started](https://yucatanbeachandcityproperties.com/buy-with-us/#process)

### Ownership Options in Mexico

Buying property in Mexico is straightforward, and the right ownership structure depends on whether you are a Mexican national or a foreign buyer.

Here’s a clear overview of how ownership works:

1\. Mexican Nationals  
Mexican citizens purchase property through a standard deed (escritura pública) held in their own name. No additional structure is required.

2\. Foreign Buyers  
Foreigners can legally own property in Mexico — including in the restricted zone (coastal and border areas) — through one of two mechanisms:

3\. Fideicomiso (Bank Trust)  
This is the most common and appropriate structure for residential buyers. A Mexican bank holds the title on your behalf, and you retain full ownership rights: you can sell, remodel, inherit, or rent the property.  
It functions very much like a living trust.

4\. Mexican Corporation  
Used only when the property will be operated as a business or when multiple properties are involved. It is not necessary for most residential purchases and is not recommended unless it fits a specific business purpose.

Our team will help you determine which option fits your situation and ensure the process is handled correctly from the start.

### Cash & Financing

Most property purchases in Mérida and the Gulf Coast are completed in cash, as traditional U.S.–Canadian–style mortgages are not available for foreign buyers in Mexico.

Local bank financing for non‑residents is essentially nonexistent, so foreign buyers typically use alternative methods to fund their purchase.

1\. Cash Purchases  
How funds are handled depends on the currency of your transaction:

2\. USD Transactions  
If your promesa or purchase contract is written in USD, we use our sister company — YBCP LLC, a separate U.S. entity — to provide secure U.S. Depository services.

This structure ensures clean, traceable transfers.

Learn more here:  
YBCP LLC – U.S. Depository Services  
https://yucatanbeachandcityproperties.com/brokerage-u-s-depository-services/

3\. MXN Transactions  
When a purchase is structured in Mexican pesos, funds are typically managed through our preferred Notario 63, who provides a secure depository account and a well‑established closing process.

If a buyer is already working with a closing attorney who has an appropriate depository structure, we can coordinate with them as well.

4\. Financing Alternatives: While Mexican banks do not offer residential mortgages to foreign buyers, there are still a few ways to finance your purchase from abroad:

a. Home equity loans or lines of credit from your home country

b. Retirement account withdrawals (when applicable)

5\. Seller financing, which is rare and generally only considered when a buyer proposes it with a significant down payment and strong terms. It is not something sellers offer, but in select cases they may agree to review it.

6\. Cross‑border financing, available through a very small number of U.S. and Canadian lenders. These loans are extremely expensive, difficult to qualify for, and can take considerable time to process. Many sellers will not agree to this option because it increases their closing costs and can delay the transaction.

We’ll help you understand which options may apply to your situation and ensure the structure is handled correctly.

### Repairs & Property Inspections

Buying property in Mérida and the Gulf Coast often involves homes of varying ages, construction styles, and maintenance histories. Mexico does not have a standardized home inspection industry, and the process here is very different from what buyers may be familiar with in the U.S. or Canada.

Property Inspections  
There is no formal inspection process in Mexico. Buyers typically walk the property with their agent and ask questions about visible conditions. Observations are limited to what can be seen at the time of the visit, and there is no comprehensive inspection report or certification process.

Repairs & Renovations  
Homes in Mérida and the Gulf Coast are generally sold in the condition you see them.

Buyers should not expect sellers to make repairs on existing issues. On occasion, a seller may agree to address a specific item, but this is not common and is handled on a case‑by‑case basis. In most situations, it is better for the buyer to handle any repairs or renovations after the purchase, when they can choose their own materials, contractors, and timelines.

### Closing Costs & Taxes

Closing costs in Mexico are higher than in the U.S. and Canada, and they vary depending on the purchase price, the notary, and the structure of the transaction. We help you understand what to expect so there are no surprises at the end of the process.  
Buyer Closing Costs

Buyers in Mexico are responsible for the majority of closing costs, which typically include:

1\. Notary & attorney fees

2\. Government registration fees

3\. Acquisition tax (ISAI)

4\. Appraisal and cadastral updates

5\. Trust (fideicomiso) setup or transfer fees, when applicable

6\. Bank fees for trust administration (if purchasing in a fideicomiso)

7\. Currency conversion or transfer fees, depending on the payment structure

8\. Closing costs generally range from 7% to 10% of the purchase price, depending on the municipality and the specifics of the transaction.

We help you understand the typical costs involved in a property purchase in Yucatán so you have a clear picture of what to expect before moving forward.

### Closing

The closing process in Mexico is different from what buyers may be familiar with in the U.S. or Canada.

While the notary (Notario Público) is the final authority who signs the deed and registers the transaction, the day‑to‑day coordination of the file is generally handled by a closing attorney.

Who Handles What

1\. Closing Attorney  
The closing attorney manages the legal file throughout the process. This includes verifying certificates, coordinating with the municipality, preparing drafts, and ensuring all legal requirements are met. Most of the work leading up to closing is handled at this level.

2\. Notary (Notario Público)  
The notary is a government‑appointed attorney who reviews the completed file, confirms legal compliance, calculates taxes, and signs the final deed. The notary does not typically manage the ongoing coordination—they sign off once the closing attorney has prepared the file.

3\. Document Collection

We collect all required documents for the party we are working with. Our role is to ensure that when we hand the file to the closing attorney, it is complete, organized, and ready for legal review. This helps prevent delays and keeps the process moving smoothly.

4\. Document Requirements  
Requirements vary depending on residency status and whether the purchase involves a fideicomiso, Mexican corporation, or personal title.

Common buyer documents include:

\- Valid passport

\- Driver’s license

\- Proof of address

\- Immigration documents (if applicable)

\- RFC (Mexican tax ID), when required

\- Marriage certificate

\- Birth certificate (occasionally requested depending on the attorney)

5\. Timeline

A closing between two Mexican nationals can sometimes be completed in as little as 4 weeks. However, any closing involving a foreign buyer will take a minimum of 2 months and often longer.

Timelines depend on:

\-The closing attorney’s workflow

\-Municipality processing times

\-Fideicomiso creation or transfer (when applicable)

\-Whether all required documents are provided promptly.

Foreign‑involved transactions frequently extend beyond the 2‑month mark due to additional documentation, bank trust requirements, and municipal processing times.

### Top 10 Tips for Buyers

1\. Work with an experienced, knowledgeable real estate company.  
Local expertise matters — it saves time, reduces risk, and helps you make informed decisions.

2\. Get your finances in order early.  
Know how you plan to fund the purchase and be prepared to show proof when needed.

3\. Set a budget and stick to it.  
A clear financial limit keeps the search focused and prevents surprises later.

4\. Understand the local housing market and culture.  
Every area has its own norms, pricing patterns, and expectations.

5\. Choose a home based on what cannot be changed.  
Location, lot size, orientation, and structural layout matter more than finishes.

6\. Don’t worry about cosmetic issues.  
Paint, décor, fixtures, and minor updates are easy to change.

7\. Know when to compromise.  
Perfect homes rarely exist — prioritize what matters most.

8\. Be open to professional guidance.  
Your agent sees patterns, risks, and opportunities you may not.

9\. Make a fair offer — avoid low‑balling.  
Unrealistically low offers often damage negotiations and reduce your chances.

10\. Understand that you cannot “time” the real estate market.  
Focus on finding the right property, not predicting market swings.

A Short Introduction to Merida Centro
-------------------------------------

The City of Mérida was founded by the Spanish conquistadors in the 1540s, on top of a centuries-old Maya city called **T'ho**.

Mérida was named after Mérida, Spain — the reason is rumored to be because the Maya ruins found in T'ho reminded the conquistadors of the Roman ruins of _Augusta Emerita_.

Over time, the city acquired the nickname **"La Ciudad Blanca"** (The White City).

This may be due to the white color of the limestone used to paint the façades of the city's colonial buildings, or, according to folklore, it refers to the founding Spanish settlers allowing only white-skinned Europeans to live within the city.

The city has the third-largest old town district (**Centro Mérida**) on the continent.

The **Cathedral of Mérida, Yucatán**, built in the late 16th century with stones from nearby Maya ruins, is the oldest cathedral in the mainland Americas.

Mérida boasts excellent museums, a vibrant street life, and a wealth of historic colonial-era architecture, including the beautiful **Cathedral San Ildefonso**.

The **Plaza Grande of Mérida**, also known as **Independence Square**, is the historical, social, and cultural heart of the capital of Yucatán — second in size only to the Zócalo in Mexico City.

Rich in colonial history and known for its narrow streets, plazas, and museums, Mérida is considered the oldest city in North America, with a history dating back to Mayan civilization times.

Besides the **Centro Histórico**, Mérida offers wonderful neighborhoods, shopping malls, parks, and a plethora of restaurants in its newer sections.

Within a 45-minute drive, you'll find the port town of **Progreso** sitting on the Gulf of Mexico, along with many beautiful beachside villages, making this the perfect location to start your dreams.

Brokerage & U.S. Depository Services
====================================

**OUR BUSINESS STRUCTURE**

Yucatán Beach and City Properties (Mexico Entity) 

Yucatán Beach and City Properties is a certified real estate brokerage based in Mérida, Yucatán. We guide clients through the full Mexican real estate process from property search and due diligence to offer, negotiation, and closing. Our team works directly with the closing attorney at every stage to help keep each transaction efficient, compliant, and transparent. We operate exclusively under Mexican law and provide bilingual support, clear communication, and a structured process designed to protect your interests.

**YBCP LLC (U.S. Entity)**

YBCP LLC is our U.S.-based administrative, depository, and compliance management entity. It does not conduct real estate brokerage in the United States. Instead, it supports our Mexico brokerage by providing the secure financial and administrative infrastructure needed for international real estate transactions. This includes U.S.-based banking protections, USD stability, structured compliance oversight, and clear documentation and financial tracking.

  

**Important Clarification** 

YBCP LLC does not perform real estate brokerage services. We operate strictly as:

• A depository

• A compliance management entity

• An administrative support structure

**Why We Use Two Companies** 

Real estate activities in Mexico must be conducted locally under Mexican law. However, many administrative, financial, and compliance functions are safer and more transparent when handled under U.S. law, especially for international buyers purchasing in USD. Using two entities allows us to combine the strengths of both systems: local expertise and legal compliance in Mexico, paired with U.S.-based financial security, documentation, and administrative oversight.

**How This Structure Benefits Clients** 

By combining the strengths of both entities, we provide:

• A secure U.S.-based financial environment 

• Clear documentation and accountability 

• Consistent administrative standards 

• Cross-border transparency 

• A streamlined experience from offer to closing 

• Alignment with global real estate compliance standards 

This dual-entity structure allows us to deliver the highest level of professionalism and protection while our Mexico brokerage focuses on guiding you through the real estate process on the ground.

**DEPOSITORY SERVICES**

YBCP LLC provides a secure, transparent channel for receiving, holding, and disbursing client funds related to Mexican real estate transactions. Funds remain safely held in the U.S. until closing, when they are released in one coordinated step for all components of the transaction. This structure offers the protections international buyers expect without the high fees associated with third‑party escrow services.

**DEPOSITORY SERVICES FOR CLIENTS WORKING WITH OTHER REAL ESTATE COMPANIES**

YBCP LLC’s secure U.S.-based depository and compliance framework is also available to international buyers purchasing property in Mexico through other real estate companies, provided the transaction meets our internal criteria. This service is ideal for buyers who want added security, documentation, and financial oversight, regardless of which brokerage represents them.

**What We Provide** 

• Secure U.S.-based holding of buyer deposits 

• Clear documentation and receipts for all funds received and disbursed 

• Coordinated release of all funds at closing according to the executed contract, which may include payment to the seller, payment to the closing attorney, payment of any applicable taxes, payment of notarial fees, and other authorized disbursements as outlined in the contract.   

• Compliance oversight including AML, KYC, and Source‑of‑Funds verification 

• Administrative support for payment tracking and documentation integrity 

• A neutral, structured financial channel separate from the brokerage involved 

**FLAT, ALL-INCLUSIVE DEPOSITORY AND CONTRACT DRAFTING FEE**

YBCP LLC provides its depository service under a flat, all - inclusive low‑cost fee. This single fee covers every component required to securely structure and administer your deposit for a Mexican real estate purchase.

This includes: 

• Secure U.S.-based holding of funds 

• Bilingual contract drafting in English and Spanish, including the mandatory depository authority language.  No need to pay any third‑party for contract preparation.

• Compliance oversight including AML, KYC, and Source‑of‑Funds verification 

• Clear documentation and receipts for all funds received and disbursed 

• Coordinated release of all funds at closing according to the executed contract, which may include payment to the seller, payment to the closing attorney, payment of any applicable taxes, payment of notarial fees, and other authorized disbursements as outlined in the contract.   

• Administrative tracking and financial documentation 

Everything is included in one transparent fee. Contact us for details.

**ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA FOR DEPOSITORY SERVICES**

Depository services are available when the following conditions are met:

**1\. The purchase is for real estate in Mexico.** 

This service is exclusively for Mexican property transactions, regardless of which real estate company the buyer is working with.

**2\. YBCP LLC must draft the Offer to Purchase or Purchase Contract.** 

To provide depository services, YBCP LLC must prepare the contract because it contains the mandatory depository authority language that legally authorizes us to hold and disburse funds. All contracts are fully bilingual and drafted to meet the requirements of Mexican attorneys, notarios, and financial institutions.

This ensures: 

• Proper legal structure for U.S.-based fund handling 

• Enforceable depository authority 

• Clear, compliant disbursement instructions 

• Full protection of the buyer’s deposit 

• No additional third‑party drafting costs 

**3\. The buyer completes all compliance requirements.** 

This includes: 

• KYC identity verification 

• Source‑of‑Funds declaration 

• Supporting financial documentation 

**4\. The transaction proceeds under the legal structure established in the executed contract.** 

Once the contract is fully executed, the depository authority and disbursement instructions become legally binding. The closing attorney may have preferences, but they do not override the executed agreement. Their role is to close the transaction according to the contract.

**HOW BUYERS USING OTHER BROKERAGES BENEFIT FROM OUR DEPOSITORY SERVICE** 

International buyers who are represented by another real estate company can still choose YBCP LLC as their depository. This provides several important protections and advantages that are not typically available when wiring funds directly to Mexico or relying on informal arrangements.

Why Buyers Benefit 

• A secure U.S.-based financial environment 

• Neutral, third‑party handling of funds 

• Bilingual, legally structured contract drafting 

• Clear, documented disbursement at closing 

• Compliance oversight that protects the buyer 

• No additional third‑party drafting fees 

• Reduced risk of fraud or misrouting of funds 

**A Safer, More Transparent Experience** 

Even if you are represented by another real estate company, using YBCP LLC as your depository gives you more control, more transparency, more protection, and more confidence in the process. Your funds are handled professionally, securely, and in full alignment with the executed contract, no matter which brokerage you choose for your property search.

Why Sell With Us
----------------

Why Sell with Yucatan Beach and City Properties? 

Selling a home in Mérida or along the Yucatán coast is an important decision, and the process here may work differently than you may be accustomed to. 

Our role is to guide you through each step with professionalism, clarity and a deep understanding of how the local market operates.

Whether you live in the area full‑time or  
manage your property from abroad, we help ensure your sale is handled with care and accuracy. 

[Get started](https://yucatanbeachandcityproperties.com/market-evaluation)

### Our Approach

A Professional, Transparent, and Well‑Coordinated Process.

We focus on providing a smooth, well‑organized experience from start to finish.

This includes:

\- Guidance on pricing based on current market conditions.  
\- Clear, professional presentation of your property.  
\- Managing communication with potential buyers.  
\- Coordinating with the closing attorney.  
\- Keeping you informed throughout the process.

Our approach is grounded in professionalism, transparency, and local expertise, ensuring you always know what to expect.

### Understanding the Local Market

A Market That Attracts Local and International Buyers.

The Mérida and Yucatán coastal markets draw a wide range of buyers, many of whom arrive well‑prepared and ready to move forward when they find the right property.

Because of this, pricing and presentation play an important role in generating interest.

While every property is unique, well‑positioned homes tend to attract stronger attention early in the process.

Our goal is to help you present your property in a way that aligns with today’s buyer expectations and market conditions.

### Documentation & Preparation

Preparing for a Smooth Transaction.

Every property is different, and requirements can vary depending on the type of ownership and the specifics of the transaction.

We help you understand what is generally needed and work with you and the closing attorney to ensure everything is prepared in a timely and organized manner.

Having your information ready early supports a smoother process and helps reduce the likelihood of delays.

### Living in Your Home While Selling

Balancing Daily Life and Showings.

Many sellers continue living in their home during the listing period.

We help you balance daily comfort with maintaining a welcoming environment for potential buyers.

Simple preparation and flexibility can make a meaningful difference in how your property is received.

### The Closing Process

How Closings Work in Mexico.

Real estate closings in Mexico follow a structured legal process.

Throughout the transaction, we coordinate closely with the closing attorney, who manages the legal file and ensures that all requirements for the transfer of ownership are met.

Communication with the parties is handled primarily through our team or directly by the attorney when needed based on the specifics of the transaction.

Additionally, our Managing Broker is directly involved in all closings, providing oversight and support to help ensure a smooth and well‑organized process from start to finish.

The Notario Público finalizes the process by reviewing the completed file and signing the deed, as required by Mexican law.

Our role is to stay closely involved from start to finish, keeping you informed and helping ensure that each step moves forward smoothly and professionally.

DISCOVER Historic Progreso

Home to the World's Longest Pier
--------------------------------

Founded in 1872 by Don Juan Miguel Castro, Progreso was established to create a seaport closer to Mérida than the older port of Sisal.

Today, Progreso is known worldwide as the home of the **longest pier on the planet** — the incredible **Progreso Pier**, which stretches an astonishing **4 miles (6.5 kilometers)** into the Gulf of Mexico.

This Mexican maritime wonder turned **84 years old in 2025**, and its original steel-and-cement section has withstood decades of hurricanes. Built by the Danish firm **Christiani & Nielsen**, the pier is a true engineering marvel. Supported by **146 arches**, the original structure began construction in **1936** and was completed in **1941**.

Over the years, several renovations and expansions have extended its length, making it resemble a bridge to a distant land. Today, the **Progreso Pier** is one of the most important shipping points in the Gulf of Mexico, handling massive volumes of imports and exports daily. It has also become a growing hotspot for **cruise ships** over the past decade.

But Progreso isn’t just a hub of commerce — it’s also a lively beach town with plenty to offer:

*   **A scenic boardwalk** perfect for oceanfront strolls
    
*   **Water sports** like surfing, windsurfing, and kayaking
    
*   **Local restaurants** serving up fresh regional cuisine
    
*   **Large supermarkets** and a bustling central marketplace
    
*   **A main square**, government buildings, hotels, hospitals, and banks
    
*   **Currency exchange houses, taxis**, and charming handicraft shops
    

Beloved by locals, Progreso is the **go-to beach destination for Yucatecans**, especially during holidays. Families flock here in **Easter**, **July**, and **August** to soak up the sun, relax by the sea, and enjoy everything this coastal gem has to offer.

Art, Culture and Community Spirit
---------------------------------

Conkal Municipality, located in state of Yucatán, is known for its unique blend of modern conveniences and colonial charm.

This charming town offers a slower pace of life and is an excellent choice for retirees, remote workers, and families looking for a safe and tranquil environment.

Conkal allows residents to enjoy the best of both worlds, being close to a large city for access to large shopping malls, hospitals, excellent restaurants, and yet enjoying small town life.

Situation about 10 miles from Merida, this could be the location for you.

DISCOVER Modern Merida

Modern Merida, a Blend of Cultures
----------------------------------

Mérida is among the safest cities in Mexico, as well as in the Americas and the entire world.

It was the first city to be named American Capital of Culture in 2000, and the only city that has received the title twice, again in 2017.

Mérida has a rich cultural life which also reflects its diversity. Many free concerts, performances, and other events are held daily.

In 2015, the city was certified as an International Safe Community by the Karolinska Institute of Sweden for its high level of public security.

Forbes has ranked Mérida three times as one of the three best cities in Mexico to live, invest, and do business.

In 2022, the UN-Habitat's City Prosperity Index recognized Mérida as the city with the highest quality of life in Mexico.

Besides the Centro Histórico, Mérida offers wonderful neighborhoods, shopping malls, parks, and a plethora of restaurants in its newer sections.

Since the second half of the 20th century, Mérida has been growing enormously to the north and west.

The north is the area which has seen the greatest commercial growth, and it is here where you will find newer homes, shopping malls, hospitals, department stores, private schools, global franchises, and car dealerships.

Driving north on Prolongación de Montejo from the Centro, you will see many wonderful neighborhoods such as Montecristo, Montebello, San Ramón Norte, Montes de Amé, Vista Alegre Norte, and Altabrisa.

Middle and upper-middle class families have built everything from small homes to large walled compounds in these areas, as well as in San Esteban, San Miguel, Brisas, Jardines de Mérida, Los Pinos, Los Arcos, and Polígono 108.

Colonia México is one of the most popular areas due to the size and quality of the homes, and for its proximity to downtown Mérida and Paseo de Montejo.

This area began development in the 1940s, so many of the houses reflect a blend of modern and art deco styles, known locally as functionalism.

As wealthier families moved further from downtown, Colonia México was developed during the same time that Paseo de Montejo was extended into Prolongación de Montejo, and it is still considered an upscale area.

In the 1990s, the city expanded to the west. In the northwest, Francisco de Montejo (behind the Siglo XXI Convention Center) saw the construction of 40,000 homes.

This new development attracted residents from other parts of Mexico, especially Mexico City and areas of central Mexico.

In the southeast, Fraccionamiento Juan Pablo II (named after the popular Pope) was created, offering homes for lower-income families.

This area continues to expand across the Periférico into Ciudad Caucel and Villa Magna.

Today you see the sprawling City of Mérida, with so many wonderful neighborhoods and areas — be assured that you will find your perfect place.

We invite you to visit and see for yourself the beauty and culture of Mérida.

Discover Chicxulub Pueblo

Art, Culture and Community Spirit
---------------------------------

Chicxulub Pueblo, is small town about 12 miles outside of Merida and is known for its proximity to the Chicxulub crater, an impact crater formed by an asteroid or comet approximately 66 million years ago. This crater is significant as it is believed to be responsible for the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event, which led to the extinction of non-avian dinosaurs and other animals. The town's name, derived from the Yucatec Maya language, means 'the devil's flea'.

Chicxulub Pueblo offers a unique blend of natural beauty, cultural heritage, and modern amenities, making it a sought-after location for those seeking a high-quality of life in Mexico. One of the most popular neighborhoods is Quintas Baspul. This area is beautiful, with much greenery and very lush, making it a fantastic area to live.

DISCOVER Motul

Pueblo Mágico
-------------

Motul is one of the most underrated gems in Yucatan.

While Mérida and the beach areas often steal the spotlight as must-visit destinations, Motul is just 40 minutes from Mérida and offers a captivating blend of history, culture, and authentic Yucatecan charm that rivals any of its better-known neighbors.

Motul, Yucatán was officially declared a **Pueblo Mágico** in October 2023.

This town is part of Mexico’s _Pueblos Mágicos_ program, which recognizes towns that offer unique cultural, historical, and natural significance.

Motul is deeply rooted in Yucatecan history and culture. It was once the birthplace of Felipe Carrillo Puerto, the revered “Red Dragon of the Southeast,” and played a key role in shaping the region’s political landscape.

Boasting beautifully preserved colonial architecture with colorful facades, cobblestoned streets, a bustling central market, a vibrant culinary scene, including its delicious _“Huevos Motuleños,”_ and access to surrounding haciendas, this small town is where tradition thrives.

Discover Valladolid

The Yellow City
---------------

The Pueblo Magico of Valladolid was founded by Spanish Conquistador Francisco de Montejo's nephew on May 27, 1543. It was named after the Spanish city Valladolid. The city quickly became a major economic center due to its location between two important trade routes.

Valladolid is now the third-largest city in the state of Yucatán, about midway between Cancún and Mérida, and is a convenient base for exploring Chichén Itzá, as it’s the closest town to the ancient site.

This popular colonial and picturesque city of Valladolid is rich in history and full of culture and traditions and was once the location of rebellions and several battles between the native residents, and the Spanish conquerors.

Two major events in Mexican history occurred in Valladolid: the Caste War in 1847 and the first spark of the Mexican Revolution (the first armed uprising in the country against Porfirio Díaz's re-election) in 1910, which is celebrated every year on June 3 with various sports and cultural events, as well as a reenactment of the event.

At the heart of the city is the main square, Parque Principal Francisco Cantón Rosado. Not far from there, you’ll also find Parque de Santa Ana, just like in Mérida. In some ways, Valladolid shares a similar charm with Mérida, such as the traditional dance performances on Sunday evenings in the main square, however this lively Colonial Town definitely has its own beat.

Directly next to the main square stands Catedral de San Servasio which looks similar to Mérida’s cathedral. This church was originally built in 1545 but was demolished and rebuilt in 1706 following violent incident known as "The Crime of the Mayors". The crime occurred on the night of July 15, 1703, when Fernando Hipólito de Osorno and Pedro Gabriel Covarrubias were assassinated inside the church by order of the mayors Ruiz de Ayuso and Fernando Tovar. The church was remodeled as atonement, changing its entrance.

About 6 blocks southwest of the main square is another landmark, the Convento de San Bernardino de Siena. The monastery is next to Parque de Sisal, a small park where you can also see the large, famous colorful Valladolid letters.

Just northeast of the main square, there’s something unusual, a cenote right in the middle of town. Cenote Zací is definitely worth a visit. If you are the adventurous type, you can jump from the edge into the deep, crystal-clear water below.

Valladolid is known by two nicknames: "La Sultana del Oriente" ( The Sultan of the East) and also "La Perla del Oriente" (The Pearl of the East).

Both are well-deserved titles due to the architectural beauty of its colonial buildings, its architectural heritage from the 19th and early 20th centuries, and its vision to become a tranquil and picturesque destination, touching both history and nature, with eyes set on the future.

DISCOVER Izamal, a Magic Town

The City of Three Cultures
--------------------------

**Izamal**, located in **Yucatán, Mexico**, was the **first designated Magic Town (Pueblo Mágico)** in the state of Yucatán in **2002**. Known for its **yellow buildings**, **colonial architecture**, and **close access to Mayan ruins and cenotes**, Izamal has been **nominated for the UNESCO World Heritage Sites** list.

Izamal is named after its founder, who, according to **UNESCO**, was a priest called **Zamná**, associated with the **Maya creator god Itzamná**.

Also known by **three nicknames**:

*   **City of Three Cultures**
*   **City of Hills**
*   **Yellow City**

It is an **important archaeological site** of the **Pre-Columbian Maya civilization**. Originally founded by the **Mayans**, it was a **center of great spiritual significance**. The name **Izamal** comes from the Mayan word for _"dew falling from the sky"_.

It is one of the **oldest cities in the area** and combines **Maya history**, **colonial architecture**, and **modern life**. This blend of **Mayan**, **Spanish Colonial**, and **Modern-Day Mexican cultures** is the reason this fascinating town is often referred to as the **City of Three Cultures**.

Izamal is known as the **City of Hills** in Yucatán because its **ancient pyramids** appear to be small hills. It’s said that for a very long time, the city’s many **Maya constructions** were abandoned to the point that they looked like mounds.

Izamal's third moniker is the **Yellow City**, and it’s easy to see where that comes from: **every building in the city is painted** in this **bold bright color**. There are **countless legends** explaining why the buildings are yellow. However, the truth is that the buildings have been yellow since the **1960s**, with a **specific yellow hue standardized in 1993** for the **visit of Pope John Paul II** to the city.

**Izamal tells a story spanning over 2,500 years of occupation** — let your imagination transport you into its **storied past**.

About this property
-------------------

Located in the heart of García Ginerés—one of Mérida’s most prestigious and architecturally protected neighborhoods—Casa Azul is a beautifully restored early 20th-century colonial home that blends timeless elegance with the comforts of modern living. Set on an expansive 1,003 m² lot with a wide frontage, this property offers generous indoor and outdoor spaces, high ceilings, and refined historic details throughout.

The residence features 287.20 m² of interior living space, complemented by 84.26 m² of terraces, creating an ideal layout for both everyday living and entertaining. Original architectural elements such as double-height ceilings, pasta tile floors, and preserved wooden doors, windows, and ceiling beams highlight the home’s historic character, while thoughtful upgrades ensure contemporary functionality and efficiency.

Casa Azul offers three spacious bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, with air conditioning in the bedrooms, study, and dining room. The home includes a welcoming foyer, living room, formal dining room, fully equipped kitchen, private study, laundry area, and storage room. Bathrooms are finished with crema maya stone countertops and shower walls, and the home is built with solid masonry construction.

Outdoor living is a defining feature of the property. The lush grounds include a 13-meter lap pool with a filtration system, accent lighting, and generous surrounding terraces. An automatic irrigation system keeps the garden areas well maintained.

The property is offered turnkey and furnished, with a fully equipped kitchen, while ceiling fans and LED lighting enhance comfort throughout the interior. Additional features include solar panels with app-controlled inverter, an electric garage gate with two covered parking spaces, a security camera system, surge protection, an electronic gas meter, and modern utility systems, all designed to provide convenience, sustainability, and peace of mind.

Casa Azul has been meticulously maintained, with recent roof waterproofing, pool servicing, exterior wood treatment, and regular system maintenance, ensuring the home is in excellent condition.

The Location

García Ginerés is recognized as an architectural heritage neighborhood of Mérida, known for its grand historic homes, tree-lined streets, and peaceful residential atmosphere. The property is just 15 minutes from Mérida International Airport, two blocks from Avenida Colón, and a short drive to Paseo Montejo and the Plaza Grande.

Within walking distance, residents enjoy Parque de las Américas, neighborhood cafés, bakeries, convenience stores, and medical services, as well as easy access to Paseo 60, one of the city’s newest dining and lifestyle destinations.

Casa Azul is a rare opportunity to own a grand colonial home that honors Mérida’s architectural legacy while offering modern comfort, generous outdoor space, and an exceptional location.

About this property
-------------------

Located in the heart of Cholul, this beautiful single-floor home offers a thoughtful design, comfort, and spaciousness in a family-friendly atmosphere. This home is perfect for those seeking proximity to all the amenities that Merida North offers. 

Casa Beto features a foyer that connects to an open room with high ceilings that integrates the living and dining areas, overlooking through the large sliding door the pleasant outdoors and sunbathing the space with natural light.

The bright and spacious, enclosed kitchen is fully equipped with a built-in pantry, upper and lower cabinets, an air conditioner, a stove, and a refrigerator. A flex room that can be used as a 4th bedroom, office, or gym is situated next to the kitchen. 

  

A hallway leads to the 3 spacious bedrooms, each one with an ensuite bathroom and walk-in closet. All the bedrooms open directly to the pool area. 

  

The backyard has a perfect setting for entertaining and relaxing with a bar, a BBQ area, a covered terrace, a large swimming pool, and a sundeck. This property has a built-in staircase for easy maintenance of the roof. 

  

Additionally, the front of the property offers parking for 4 cars (two covered), a front garden/terrace, and service access. The rear of the property offers a utility room on the roof, ample storage under the stairs, a gardening area, and a laundry room with a fourth full bathroom.  

  

Casa Beto is fully loaded with 14 solar panels, a 9.8 kW battery backup, a water softener, a pressurized water system, and a pool filtration system. Home is sold furnished with appliances.

About this property
-------------------

Versatile In-Town Property with Pool – Endless Potential 

Located in a convenient in-town area of Chelem, this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home with a pool offers incredible flexibility and opportunity. 

With its spacious layout, the property presents multiple possibilities perfect as a comfortable full-time residence, a multi-family investment property, or even a restaurant or commercial space with private living quarters above. 

With a little work and vision, you can truly transform this property into exactly what you want—tailored to your lifestyle or business goals. 

Enjoy a private pool for relaxing or entertaining, along with secure off-street covered parking for added convenience and peace of mind. All of this is just moments from local shops, dining, and the beach. 

Whether you're looking to live, invest, or create something unique, this property provides the ideal foundation.

About this property
-------------------

This 3-house complex offers a "Private Resort" experience.

  

• Lot: 895 m² | Construction Area: Over 600 m²

  

• Layout: 3 complete houses, 5 bedrooms (all with ensuite bathrooms), 5.5 bathrooms total + outdoor shower.

  

• Kitchens: 3 indoor + 1 outdoor.

  

• Parking: Covered garage/workshop with water and drainage connections.

  

Technical Specifications Included:

  

• Climate Control: 17 high-efficiency A/C units and LED ceiling fans.

  

• Windows: Tinted glass with screens throughout the property.

  

• Sustainability: Photovoltaic solar system and on-demand water heaters.

  

• Gas: Two 300L stationary tanks and two independent electrical connections.

  

• Amenities: Jacuzzi, hot tub.

  

  

  

The Heart of the Property:

  

Enjoy a spectacular 10-meter-long filtered pool with a waterfall, LED lighting, and a depth of up to 1.80 meters. The outdoor area is complemented by an outdoor kitchen, four covered patios, retractable awnings, and lush landscaping maintained by underground sprinkler irrigation.

  

Magazine-Worthy Interiors:

  

• Chef's Kitchens: Equipped with high-end GE Profile appliances, including built-in ovens and garbage disposals.

  

• Design Details: Hand-finished plaster walls and ceilings, giant skylights that flood the spaces with natural light, and four sliding glass walls that seamlessly integrate the interior with the garden.

  

• Entertainment: Includes six large-format Sony screens and a versatile bonus room (art studio/workshop) with a hidden Murphy bed for guests.

Just 4 blocks from Santiago Park and various places such as restaurants, supermarkets, pharmacies, and coffee shops;

9 blocks from the Mérida town square;

10 ​​minutes from the airport; and 30 minutes from Progreso beach.

Explore Merida
--------------

Merida, Yucatan is a vibrant historic city best known as the cultural capital of Latin America. Ancient Maya cities, stunning cenotes and majestic haciendas dot the countryside of the Yucatan. Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf Coast is just a short drive away. Most importantly, Merida is considered the safest city in the western hemisphere. Merida is now one of the top destinations for retirement, investment, and living.

About this property
-------------------

Behind a striking façade of clean architectural lines, Casa de Agaves reveals a private sanctuary of modern design, comfort, and tranquility in one of Mérida’s most sought-after neighborhoods. This fully renovated Mexican Modern residence blends sophisticated style with thoughtful functionality, offering a seamless indoor-outdoor lifestyle just minutes from the vibrant heart of the city.

  

Spanning approximately 215 m² across two levels, the home is filled with natural light, enhanced by tall ceilings, generous windows, and airy, beautifully curated interiors. Every space has been designed with flow and ease of living in mind, complemented by custom high-end tzalam wood furnishings and elegant, neutral finishes throughout.

  

Casa de Agaves features a gracious formal living room at the front, while the rear opens into a spacious entertainment lounge complete with a granite-topped bar, custom cabinetry, a bar sink, and a comfortable seating area. This inviting space overlooks the lush tropical garden and filtered swimming pool, creating the perfect setting for entertaining or relaxing in total privacy.

  

At the heart of the home, the chef’s kitchen is both stylish and functional, showcasing upgraded LG appliances, granite countertops, and a large central island ideal for casual dining and gathering. A dedicated dining room offers a more formal space for hosting.

  

Upstairs, two generously sized primary suites provide comfort and privacy, each featuring walk-in closets, en-suite bathrooms, and access to private terraces. An interior courtyard with a hammock adds a serene, distinctly Yucatán touch.

  

Step outside to your own tropical retreat. Lush landscaping and palm trees frame the fully finished garden, which centers around a sparkling filtered pool with a Baja deck. A pergola-covered terrace with lounge seating creates an ideal outdoor living space for year-round enjoyment.

This home is designed for effortless living, featuring five air conditioning units, ceiling fans throughout, and natural cooling that keeps the home comfortable year-round. With 15 solar panels, energy efficiency is a standout feature. Additional amenities include a spacious bodega with a laundry area, irrigation system, water softener, voltage regulator, tankless electric water heater, gas service, and smart home security with full perimeter cameras and a Ring doorbell.

  

Built to high standards by a renowned builder, the property offers enhanced privacy and security, including no connecting rooftops to neighboring homes. Located on a quiet, non-bus-route street, it provides both peace of mind and convenience.

  

Located in Barrio Santiago, bordering San Sebastián, Casa de Agaves is just 10 minutes from Paseo de Montejo and Calle 47’s renowned restaurant row. Enjoy quick access to La Ermita, the Zócalo, the ADO station, the Mérida Zoo, and the airport just 15 minutes away.

  

Offered fully furnished and turnkey, including appliances and an assortment of art and décor, this home is ready for immediate enjoyment—perfect as a low-maintenance full-time residence or private vacation retreat.

  

Ready to Sell! Documentation Verified

  
The property is currently subject to a mortgage with Moxi. The payment to the seller and lender will be executed at closing through the escrow (depository) service.

About this property
-------------------

Casa Irmita is a fully restored residence conveniently situated in Barrio San Sebastián. 

  

The front of the property offers ample secure parking and a wonderful buffer from the street. Past the parking area, you will enter into a welcoming living room that flows into a dining room with beautiful accent lights. 

Continue through the home to the spacious, fully equipped kitchen. A full bathroom is conveniently located at the rear of the home for the guest and accessible from the pool. Across from the bathroom is the laundry area. 

  

Step outside to your private backyard featuring an open terrace, greenery, a refreshing swimming pool with a water feature, and a BBQ area—perfect for summer barbecues or tranquil evenings. 

  

Upstairs await two sizable bedrooms with built-in closets and a private terrace.

  

Between the two bedrooms located on the landing is the shared full bathroom. Each bedroom offers plenty of natural light and breezes.

About this property
-------------------

This is a WOW home! Casa Nala is a spectacular, well-designed, single-floor home that exudes traditional charm and modern comfort. Located in Barrio San Sebastián, homeowners will find the home to be conveniently located to San Sebastián, La Ermita, and San Juan parks in a quick jaunt.

From the moment you step inside, you will be amazed by the architectural features, such as the original pasta tiles, the dovela-style roof, decorative stone walls, and concrete finishes that give this property its character. 

Casa Nala boasts 2 bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms and a flex room that can be used as a third bedroom, office, or TV room, plus a full guest bedroom. 

  

The social area is centrally located, featuring a fully equipped kitchen with an island, dishwasher, and pantry that opens into the dining room. The main living area overlooks the outdoor oasis through the iron glass wall that bathes the interior with natural light. 

  

The pool patio is a sanctuary with mature trees, lushed gardens, an infinity pool with a water feature, a barbecue area, and a water pond, creating a relaxing ambiance for enjoying with the family and entertaining the guests. 

  

Casa Nala is a beautiful property that combines comfort and history, quietly located in a corner of San Sebastián.

Thoughtfully built with quality materials and a clean, contemporary design, this property offers a seamless blend of comfort, style, and efficiency in a quiet area with easy beach access. 

The home features 2 spacious bedrooms, along with a versatile office/mini-gym that can easily adapt to your lifestyle needs. In addition, a private second-story studio / in-law suite provides incredible flexibility—ideal for guests, extended family, rental income, or a private retreat space. With 3 well-appointed bathrooms—including a private ensuite in the primary bedroom with a walk-in closet, a guest bathroom, and a convenient ground-floor bath—this home ensures comfort and privacy for both residents and guests. 

Enjoy a bright and inviting living space centered around a custom-designed kitchen with beautiful granite countertops and handcrafted cedar cabinetry, complemented by custom cedar doors throughout the home, adding warmth and a high-end, natural finish. The kitchen comes fully equipped and is ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Step outside to your private swimming pool, creating the perfect setting for relaxation or hosting in your own coastal retreat. 

Included appliances and features add exceptional value, including a Samsung French door refrigerator, Koblenz Monaco luxury stove, washing machine, gas dryer, chest freezer, and a 6-camera CCTV security system. Curtains are installed in key living spaces, and the primary suite features a stylish French-style bathtub. 

Additional highlights include: 

• Air conditioning throughout (including bedrooms, office, and studio suite) 

• Ceiling fans in every room 

• Screened doors throughout the home for airflow and comfort 

• Interior and exterior lighting 

• Mirrors in all bathrooms 

• Dedicated laundry area 

Located in a peaceful setting, this pet-friendly property offers beach access and combines modern construction with upscale custom finishes. The added second-story suite enhances the home’s versatility, making it ideal as a full-time residence, vacation home, or income-producing investment.

About this property
-------------------

Casa Carpintero is a stunning, contemporary home designed to offer both elegance and functionality. This brand new construction features 3 spacious bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, making it perfect for families or those who love to entertain. An abundance of natural light flows effortlessly through the spaces and expansive windows, ensuring a refreshing airflow throughout the home. 

The beautifully designed kitchen is complete with modern finishes, granite countertops, and the sleek cabinetry, making it ideal for family meals or entertaining friends. Adjacent to the kitchen is a spacious living room with views of the central patio. 

Outdoor living extends to the swimming pool, which features a stone wall and water feature that create a tranquil ambiance. The covered terrace offers the perfect setting for outdoor dining and entertaining. 

  

At the rear of the property is a two-story casita with 2 spacious bedrooms with built-in closets and full bathrooms. The upstairs bedroom has a front terrace, and the downstairs has an interior garden that bathes the space in natural light. The main house of Casa Carpintero has a third bedroom and a full guest bathroom for added convenience. 

  

Additional features include infrastructure prepared for solar panels and a water softener system, which add to the ease of living in this beautifully crafted home.

About this property
-------------------

Welcome to Casa Clavel, a beautifully renovated single-level home situated in the historic and vibrant Barrio La Ermita. Blending modern comforts with timeless charm, this residence offers an inviting open floor plan perfect for relaxed living and entertaining. The bright, open kitchen is the centerpiece of the home, featuring a large island, sleek finishes, and seamless flow to the living and dining areas.

Outdoors, a private oasis awaits. The filtered pool with water feature provides the perfect backdrop for gatherings or quiet afternoons, while private off-street parking adds convenience and peace of mind.  
  
Casa Clavel offers 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths and provides plenty of space for full time living. Home is sold furnished with appliances included.

With its character, updates, and quiet location in La Ermita, just a short stroll from charming history, art, and culture, this home is a must see!

About this property
-------------------

Welcome to your dream home! **Casa 57** is a lovingly maintained, single-level home that is the perfect retreat for homebuyers seeking a convenient location and a tranquil lifestyle. Featuring 2 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, **Casa 57** is a harmonious blend of comfort and space. 

Step inside to discover a bright and airy open-concept living area with beautiful original pasta tile flooring that adds a touch of traditional charm. The fully furnished interior showcases stylish décor and ample natural light, creating a welcoming ambiance. The inviting eat-in, fully equipped kitchen, complete with custom cabinetry, is ideal for entertaining. 

**Casa 57** offers a beautiful outdoor living space, where you will find a swimming pool nestled within a tropical garden and an open-air terrace. The property offer secure parking for 1 car garage. 

With its convenient location, the homeowners are just minutes away from local shops, restaurants and all the amenities of downtown Merida. 

  

**Location:** 

*   6 Blocks to Chembech Market   
    
*   10 Blocks to La Mejorada Park   
    
*   10 Blocks to Patio Mall  
    
*   14 Blocks to La Plancha Park

Explore Merida
--------------

Merida, Yucatan is a vibrant historic city best known as the cultural capital of Latin America. Ancient Maya cities, stunning cenotes and majestic haciendas dot the countryside of the Yucatan. Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf Coast is just a short drive away. Most importantly, Merida is considered the safest city in the western hemisphere. Merida is now one of the top destinations for retirement, investment, and living.

About this property
-------------------

With a fantastic location, Casa El Amanecer is a stunning home that situates the homeowners in the hot spots of Centro such as Santa Ana, Paseo Montejo, 47 Street and La Plancha Park within walking distance.

Featuring high ceilings through the residence, this restored two-story colonial home welcomes with a living room, secondary living room, and expansive kitchen complete with an island, breakfast bar, custom made cabinets and a large pantry room. 

  

Step outside and discover the tropical paradise with a generously sized covered terrace flanked by arches, bbq area, swimming pool and garden that promises endless moments of relaxation and makes it a perfect spot for entertainment.  Additional features include a pool bath and an outdoor shower.

  

On the first floor there are two good size secondary bedrooms with a closet and full bathroom. 

  

Climb upstairs and discover the sanctuary of the homeowners with a primary bedroom complete with a full bathroom with double vanity and a walk-in closet offering privacy and comfort. The second floor also integrates a nice office, laundry room and two terraces. 

  

Casa El Amanecer offers 14 solar panels, pressurized water, water softener, mini-split units, kitchen appliances and garage.

About this property
-------------------

Casa Linda is a fantastic opportunity to own a property in the picturesque Baspul neighborhood of Chicxulub Pueblo. This residential complex features tree-lined avenues, colorful facades, and a relaxed residential atmosphere. 

Featuring a living space split in two levels, homebuyers are welcomed by a front garden that sets an inviting tone. Inside, the open-concept design with a double-high ceiling provides a bright and breezy social area. The eat-in kitchen includes appliances, concrete countertops, and an island with a breakfast bar for casual meals. The first floor features a convenient bedroom with closet space, a private interior garden, and a full guest bathroom.  
  
The living space is opens to charming garden with terrace, a circular dipping pool and a fun wall mural

  

The second floor offers a cozy reading nook, a second spacious bedroom with a private terrace, and a full bathroom.

  

Casa Linda is being sold partially furnished and fully equipped with appliances!

  

Location: 

22 minutes to Gulf of Mexico

25 minutes to Altabrisa

48 minutes to Merida Centro

50 minutes to Merida International Airport

Consumer Bill of Rights
-----------------------

* * *

Consumer Bill of Rights

In accordance with the Federal Consumer Protection Law, its Regulations, and in compliance with the provisions of Mexican Official Standard NOM-247-SE-2021, through this document, “Yucatan Beach Property S. DE R.L. DE C.V.”, commercially known as “Yucatan Beach and City Properties, Yucatan Beach and City Property and YBCP”, hereinafter “YBCP”, declares and acknowledges that, in every commercial transaction involving the purchase and sale of a home or land, our clients have the following RIGHTS:

1\. To receive, regarding the real estate offered, truthful, clear, and up-to-date information and advertising, regardless of the means of communication, including digital media, in such a way that allows them to make the best purchasing decision, knowing with certainty the characteristics of the property they are acquiring, in accordance with the provisions of the Law.

2\. To know the information regarding the characteristics of the property, including: the land area, the constructed area, the type of structure, the facilities, the finishes, the accessories, parking space, use of common areas, available services, and the general condition of the property.

3\. Freely choose the property that best suits your needs and purchasing power.

4\. You will not make any payments until the contractual relationship is recorded in writing, except for those related to down payments and operating expenses, under the terms established by the Federal Consumer Protection Law.

5\. Sign an adhesion contract, legally binding purchase agreement reflecting the mutual consent of the buyer and seller, enforceable in accordance with applicable real estate legislation and conforming to the model registered with the Federal Consumer Protection Agency, which establishes the terms and conditions of the property purchase. After signing, the seller is obligated to provide a copy of the signed contract to the consumer.

6\. Acquire a property that meets the safety and quality standards established by applicable regulations and reflected in the information and advertising you have received.

7\. If the Consumer decides to purchase a property within a development governed by a contract of adhesion, they acknowledge that the terms have been unilaterally established by the developer. However, the Buyer retains the right to receive the property in accordance with the agreed conditions, to access local legal remedies in the event of noncompliance, and to challenge any clause that may be considered abusive or contrary to consumer protection laws.

8\. If applicable, exercise the guarantees on real estate provided for in the Federal Consumer Protection Law, considering the specifications established in the respective adhesion contract.

9\. Receive the corresponding compensation under the Federal Consumer Protection Law if, after exercising the guarantee, defects or faults in the property persist. Likewise, the Buyer may make the necessary repairs in the event of defects or faults attributable to the seller, or opt for the replacement of the property or the termination of the contract, when appropriate.

10\. Access to free and accessible channels and mechanisms for inquiries, requests, complaints, and suggestions to YBCP, and the address provided by YBCP to receive notifications.

11\. The right to protection by the competent authorities in accordance with applicable law, including the right to file complaints and claims with them.

12\. Access to a Privacy Notice to understand how the personal data you provide will be processed and, where appropriate, to consent to it; to have your personal data processed in accordance with applicable law; and to know the mechanisms available to exercise your rights of Access, Rectification, Erasure, and Objection.

13\. Receive treatment free of discrimination, without denying or conditioning the service or sale of a home based on gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual preference, religion, or any other particularity, in accordance with applicable law.

14\. Freely choose the notary public who will execute the deed.

Carta de Derechos del Consumidor 

En términos  
de la Ley Federal de Protección al Consumidor, su Reglamento y en cumplimiento  
con lo dispuesto en la Norma Oficial Mexicana NOM-247-SE-2021, mediante el  
presente documento, “Yucatan Beach Property S. DE R.L. DE C.V.”, conocido  
comercialmente como “Yucatan Beach and City Properties, Yucatan Beach and City  
Property y YBCP”, en adelante “YBCP”, manifiesta y reconoce que, en toda  
transacción comercial de compraventa de vivienda o terreno, nuestros clientes  
tienen los siguientes DERECHOS:

1\. Recibir,  
respecto de los bienes inmuebles ofrecidos, información y publicidad veraz,  
clara y actualizada, independientemente del medio de comunicación, incluidos  
los medios digitales, de tal manera que le permita tomar la mejor decisión de  
compra, conociendo con certeza las características del inmueble que adquiere,  
de conformidad con lo dispuesto en la Ley.

2\. Conocer  
la información sobre las características del inmueble, entre ellas: la  
extensión del terreno, la superficie construida, el tipo de estructura, las  
instalaciones, los acabados, los accesorios, el espacio de estacionamiento, el  
uso de las áreas comunes, los servicios disponibles y el estado general del  
inmueble.

3\. Elija  
libremente el inmueble que mejor se adapta a sus necesidades y a su capacidad  
adquisitiva.

4\. No  
realizará ningún pago hasta que la relación contractual quede registrada por  
escrito, excepto los relativos a anticipos y gastos de operación, en los  
términos previstos por la Ley Federal de Protección al Consumidor.

5\. Firmar un contrato de adhesión, acuerdo de compra legalmente vinculante que refleja el consentimiento mutuo del comprador y el vendedor,  ejecutable conforme a la legislación  
inmobiliaria aplicable y conforme al modelo registrado en la Procuraduría  
Federal del Consumidor, en el que se establecen los términos y condiciones de  
la compraventa del inmueble. Tras la firma, el vendedor tiene la obligación de  
entregar una copia del contrato firmado al consumidor.

6\. Adquirir  
un inmueble que cuente con las características de seguridad y calidad que se  
establecen en la normativa aplicable y se refleja en la información y  
publicidad que haya recibido.

7\. Si el  
Consumidor decide adquirir una propiedad dentro de un desarrollo regido por un  
contrato de adhesión, reconoce que los términos han sido establecidos  
unilateralmente por el desarrollador. No obstante, el Comprador conserva el  
derecho de recibir la propiedad conforme a las condiciones pactadas, de acceder  
a recursos legales locales en caso de incumplimiento, y de impugnar cualquier  
cláusula que pueda considerarse abusiva o contraria a las leyes de protección  
al consumidor.

8\. En su  
caso, ejercer las garantías sobre bienes inmuebles previstas en la Ley Federal  
de Protección al Consumidor, considerando las especificaciones establecidas en  
el respectivo contrato de adhesión.

9\. Recibir  
la compensación o compensación correspondiente en términos de la Ley Federal de  
Protección al Consumidor, en caso de que, una vez ejercida la garantía,  
persistan defectos o fallas en la propiedad. Asimismo, a realizar las  
reparaciones necesarias en caso de defectos o fallas imputables al vendedor, u  
optar por la sustitución de la propiedad o la rescisión del contrato cuando  
corresponda.

10\. Contar  
con canales y mecanismos de atención gratuitos y accesibles para consultas,  
solicitudes, reclamaciones y sugerencias a YBCP, y conocer la dirección  
indicada por YBCP para recibir notificaciones.

11\. Derecho  
a la protección por parte de las autoridades competentes y de conformidad con  
la legislación aplicable, incluyendo el derecho a presentar quejas y  
reclamaciones ante ellas.

12\. Tener a  
su disposición un-Aviso de Privacidad para conocer el tratamiento que se dará a  
los datos personales que proporcione y, en su caso, consentirlo; que sus datos  
personales sean tratados de conformidad con la normativa aplicable y conocer  
los mecanismos disponibles para ejercer sus derechos de Acceso, Rectificación,  
Cancelación y Oposición.

13\. Recibir  
un trato libre de discriminación, sin que se pueda negar ni condicionar la  
atención o venta de una vivienda por motivos de género, nacionalidad, etnia,  
preferencia sexual, religión o cualquier otra particularidad, en los términos  
de la legislación aplicable.

14\. Elegir  
libremente al notario público que lleve a cabo la escrituración.

About this property
-------------------

Just 20 meters from the International Malecón in Progreso, Casa Colibri is a spacious beach-view property that offers a rare blend of space, privacy, and investment potential. The single-level home features 5 spacious bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms, designed for comfort and effortless coastal living.

The front half of the property includes two separate rental units, each with its kitchenette, and one larger unit with its own living room. The rental income area has its own pool and access to the rooftop palapa, providing guests with views of the Gulf of Mexico.  
  
A very deep stretch of beach and natural greenery create a serene buffer between the house and the shoreline. Located in a highly walkable area just steps from the Malecón, you’ll have effortless access to restaurants, shops, and local attractions while still enjoying a peaceful retreat.

The main house features an open-concept living space with high ceilings. Just off the main living space are two spacious bedrooms with en suite bathrooms and water views. A large terrace provides the perfect hangout spot for the house with a sitting area and outdoor dining space.

Casa Colibri is sold furnished with appliances, air conditioning, and solar panels. The property also offers off-street parking, a hidden utility area with laundry, and a large bodega offering ample storage for the property.

Whether you're looking for a private coastal residence, a vacation getaway, or an income-producing property, this unique home delivers it all.

Disclaimer:

The garden and pool area in the photos and video are located within an easement and not part of the legal property. This area is solely accessed by the owners, but legal rights or title to this land are not included.
