About this property
-------------------

Casa Mariposa is a beautiful traditional colonial located on a quiet side street just 6 blocks from Plaza Grande. This location provides homebuyers with a short stroll to Merida's main market areas, La Ermita and San Sebastian, while also offering a spacious sanctuary away from the bustle of Centro. 

The property has a flexible layout, with two independent homes located on it. The single-level main house, which has direct street access, offers the traditional colonial vibes with high ceilings, thick mampostería walls, and pasta floors. The main house includes a living room, a dining room, three bedrooms, three full baths, a covered terrace, and a spacious kitchen with an island. 

The rear casita-style house features a spacious open floor plan with a large interior garden, kitchen, upstairs living room, second-floor guest bedroom with a full bath and balcony, and second-floor principal bedroom with a walk-in closet, full bath, and balcony.

  

The casita has independent access through the driveway located on the side of the main house. The two houses share the spacious gardens, which feature an outdoor bar, a covered BBQ, a laundry room, a pool bath, and a large filtered pool. There is easy roof access for maintenance and for roof terrace potential.

  
The well-thought-out layout offers home buyers options to live and earn income. Run the home as a bed and breakfast or rent one part of the property as a separate rental unit. 

  

Casa Mariposa has a color palette that embraces the warmth and vibrance of Mexico. 

This charming home is sold fully furnished with appliances. Begin to live and earn income immediately after closing.

About this property
-------------------

Step into a world where history meets modern elegance. This fully restored, grand, colonial residence is a treasure trove of character and charm, nestled in the traditional Barrio of San Cristobal. 

This property offers endless potential boasting 11 versatile rooms and 2 full bathrooms. Adorned with colonial beams and original doors, the home radiates timeless beauty, enhanced by mampostería wall that tell a story of craftsmanship and local tradition. 

Experience tranquility in the stunning central courtyard with its artisanal stone walls, surrounded by lush greenery– a serene space perfect for relaxation.

  

Whether you envision a family home, a boutique hotel, or a creative workspace, the adaptable layout allows for various configurations to suit your needs. Casa Celeste is a sound investment opportunity for those looking to enter the flourishing real estate market in Mérida. 

  

Location: 

1 Block to San Cristobal Park

1.5 Blocks to San Benito & Lucas de Galvez Markets

5.5 Blocks to La Mejorada Park

6.5 Blocks to San Juan Park

8.5 Blocks to Plaza Grande

10.5 Blocks to La Plancha Park

DISCOVER Pueblo Mágico, Village of Sisal

Art, Culture and Community Spirit
---------------------------------

Sisal, now recognized as Pueblo Mágico, is one of the ports with great historical, cultural and natural heritage in the State of Yucatan, since in colonial times it was a point of great importance for the commercialization of various products such as fiber from henequen, cocoa, cotton, among others. Empress Carlota Amalia built a property to establish in this place, not only because of the economic attractiveness that it represented in her time, but because she was struck by the beauty of the port.

It is located just 53 kilometers / 32 miles northeast of Mérida, Sisal is a quiet and small place, a fishing port where people are friendly and hospitable, making this an ideal place for those who seek to get away from the hustle and bustle of everyday life.

Its main attraction is its beaches of green tones that contrast with the soft white sand, surrounded by dunes and palm trees that immediately invite you to lie down, sunbathe and cool off for a while.

In addition to the beach, you can appreciate many historical buildings that have survived over time, such as the Maritime Customs, The House of the Empress Carlota, the Fort of Santiago, El Faro and the cannons located in the central park that were witnesses of defense against pirates in ancient times.

The pier is the place for those who enjoy fishing, relaxing and waiting for your catch or to just take in the view.

A tour that you cannot miss is the boat tour through the El Palmar State Reserve, where you will be taken to explore the mangroves that inside protect a great marine fauna and a great variety of endemic and migratory birds that find shelter here. You may be lucky enough to see crocodiles, jellyfish, flamingos, pelicans, cormorants, raccoons, herons.

The gastronomy of this place is based on fresh seafood of the day, but you can also find traditional and typical food. There are many restaurants, inns and houses that offer delicious food daily for those who visit Sisal beach.

Recognized in 2020 as a Magic Town, various rescue and restoration works have been carried out on the port. During your visit to Yucatan, don't forget to visit this beautiful Magic Town called Sisal.

You may have heard this area referred to as “The Montes”; Montecristo, Montebello, Monterreal, Montes de Ame, and Montecarlo.

New modern townhouses, high-rises, modern condo complexes, and apartments have a variety of price ranges. The neighborhoods feature green spaces, gyms, shopping centers, restaurants, parks, and much, much more. This area is considered the cosmopolitan area of The North and suburbs of Mérida.

DISCOVER Telchac Puerto Telchac Puerto, 30 minutes from Progreso

Art, Culture and Community Spirit
---------------------------------

Located 65 km / 40 miles northeast of Merida and a 45 minutes’ drive, is the beautiful port of Telchac, this is the starting point of the coast to other beaches such as Yucatan, San Crisanto, Chabihau, Santa Clara and Dzilam Bravo, you can also pass by Uaymitum where you can spot pink flamingos that migrate in the summer months.

Telchac is a serene little village where the main square is surrounded by trees, and places to sit and relax. Its small pier and the lighthouse is the perfect place to watch the sunsets … and enjoy the tranquility of the water.

The white sandy beaches, which boast calm turquoise waters, are ideal for sunbathing and swimming. Early in the day you can see fishermen who leave or are returning from the day’s catch.

There are restaurants with a variety of dishes based on fish and seafood, as well as shops where if you want you can buy souvenirs, sweets or fruit. It is recommended that you bring cash. Close to Telchac you can find the Xcambo Mayan Ruins, it is worth a visit.

DISCOVER Itzimna

Art, Culture and Community Spirit
---------------------------------

This area was once a **separate Mayan village** on the **northeastern outskirts** of the original city limits of **Mérida**. The first **colonial building** constructed here was, naturally, the **church**, originally built as a **chapel for the Indigenous population**. Part of the original chapel is believed to form the **sanctuary of the current church in Itzimná**, which was built in the **18th century**.

**Itzimná** became an area where **wealthy hacienda owners** built their **summer homes**. It’s hard to believe that this neighborhood was once considered **far from the city**! Today, Itzimná is known for its **magnificent, sprawling homes**, many of which have since been **repurposed for different uses**.

The **church of Itzimná** remains a **local favorite**, often chosen as the **site of weddings** due to its **charm and beauty**. It is surrounded by a **large square with shaded trees**, creating a peaceful setting. The area is also home to **numerous public and private schools**, as well as **dance and art schools** and **a variety of restaurants**.

DISCOVER García Ginerés & Colonia Buenavista

Art, Culture and Community Spirit
---------------------------------

Originally, this area was the land of a **hacienda called Dátil y Limón (Date and Lemon),** located far outside Mérida. In the **late 19th century**, **Don Cosme Ángel Villajuana** purchased the hacienda, renaming it **San Cosme** after himself and his **patron saint**.

In **1904**, a **Spaniard with real estate expertise, Don Joaquín García Ginerés**, bought the hacienda, divided the land, and sold plots. Initially, people were hesitant to buy property so far from the city. When **Don Joaquín** passed away in **1915**, the area was officially named **García Ginerés** in his honor.

##### **García Ginerés Today**

Now a **mostly residential area**, García Ginerés is divided by the **busy, one-way Avenida Colón**. The **wide streets** are lined with a mix of **older and modern homes**, mostly built within the last **50 years**. While there are **elegant, expensive homes**, the area also has **more modest residences**, making it an **upper-middle-class enclave**.

At the heart of the neighborhood, on the **corner of Calle 20 and Avenida Colón**, stands **Parque de Las Américas**, a stunning **Mayan Art Deco-style** park completed in **1946**.

##### **Parque de Las Américas**

The park is divided into **four quadrants**, featuring:

*   **Monuments** honoring the countries of **North and South America**, celebrating **pre-Hispanic cultures** and **socialist ideals** in contrast to the area’s colonial Spanish heritage.
*   A **large fountain** in one section.
*   A **half-shell open-air auditorium** for performances.
*   The **José Martí Cultural Center** in another quadrant.
*   A **fenced-off children’s play area**.

Rumor has it that a **cenote** once existed beneath the **concha** (performance space). Today, locals enjoy the park’s **shade, cultural events, and jogging paths**, while weekends often feature **athletic and cultural gatherings**.

##### **Slow Food Market – Every Saturday, 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM**

Part of the **global Slow Food movement**, this market promotes **culinary traditions, regional organic produce, and healthy eating**. Arrive **early** for the best selections, as vendors often sell out before noon. **Bring your own shopping bags!**

DISCOVER Aleman

Art, Culture and Community Spirit
---------------------------------

The area known as **Alemán** was one of **Mérida’s first planned developments**. Built in **1957**, it was named after **Mexico’s former president at the time, Miguel Alemán**. Originally designed as a **federally funded housing project for workers**, it stood out as the **only colonia with a sewer system**—a distinction it still holds today! It was also the **first colonia in the city to receive city water**.

**Alemán** is thoughtfully designed, with **wide, tree-lined streets and avenues**. In its early days, it consisted of **small houses**, but over time, residents **purchased adjacent plots** to build **larger, more modern homes**. Today, it is considered an **upper-middle-class area** with **fairly modern residences**.

Though primarily **residential**, Alemán features a **few retail shops and restaurants**. Its location is ideal, situated **halfway between the Historic Center and Mérida’s major commercial hubs**, including:

*   **Plaza Fiesta** – Mérida’s oldest mall
*   **Alta Brisa Mall** – A modern shopping destination
*   **Star Médica Hospital** – One of the city’s top medical facilities

Alemán remains a **well-planned, desirable neighborhood**, offering a **balance of history, convenience, and modern living**.

DISCOVER Cholul

Art, Culture and Community Spirit
---------------------------------

Like **Chuburná**, **Cholul** was once a **comisaría** with its **own local government** and **ejido land**. When **henequén production** declined, the land became **its only valuable asset**. With **no other industries** to sustain them, residents began **selling their land in the 1990s** to wealthy **Meridanos**, sparking a wave of development.

Today, **Cholul** still retains its **small, peaceful pueblo charm**, centered around a **large town square with an old church**. The area is uniquely diverse, home to **some of Mérida’s richest families**, as well as **some of its poorest**, with a **sprinkle of foreign residents** adding to the mix.

**Cholul** is widely regarded as a **desirable place to live**, offering a **tranquil atmosphere** with **easy access to all the conveniences of Mérida**.

DISCOVER The Yucatan Country Club

Art, Culture and Community Spirit
---------------------------------

The Yucatan Country Club is considered one of the best communities to live in Latin America and distinguished by the fine architecture of its luxurious Clubhouse.  
Yucatan Country has, within its walls, world-class restaurants and bars, as well as tennis, golf and swimming academies, soccer and paddle courts, gym, spa, spectacular pools and recreational areas, among many other amenities, all framed by El Jaguar, an 18-hole golf course with natural cenotes and breathtaking views.  
The course "El Jaguar" was designed by legendary professional golfer, Jack Nicklaus. This par 72 course is renowned for its unique design that incorporates Mayan archaeological remnants and cenotes, making it a distinctive and culturally rich experience for golfers.  
This exclusive development, which combines its excellent geographic location with an innovative planned community, delights the senses with its residential environment surrounded by security and exclusivity, where one breathes well-being and harmony.

The design of Altozano, showcases independent clusters with individual access control which offer exclusive, private and very comfortable areas to live in.

About this property
-------------------

In the charming seaside fishing village of San Crisanto, just a couple of blocks from the vibrant town square, you'll find this stunning renovated beachfront home that’s perfect as a second residence or an amazing rental opportunity!

The house has been thoughtfully updated and boasts two spacious bedrooms and two modern bathrooms. The airy and inviting open layout of the living room, dining area, and kitchen create a welcoming atmosphere. Step outside to discover a lovely expansive yard featuring a refreshing swimming pool! Plus, the robust stone wall design paired with a beautiful palapa roof terrace offers incredible views of the large pool area. And let’s not forget the fantastic pool bar — the ideal spot to soak up those lazy, sunny afternoons!

With air conditioning and ceiling fans throughout, you’ll stay comfortable year-round. The property is also safeguarded by a sturdy sea wall, ensuring that you’re just steps away from the stunning beach and the sparkling waters of the Gulf of Mexico. 

Don’t miss out on this incredible opportunity to own a slice of paradise!

Explore San Cristano
--------------------

If you are looking for a place to relax and enjoy the natural beauty of the Yucatan Peninsula, San Crisanto might be the perfect destination for you. San Crisanto is a small fishing village that offers a semi-virgin beach, a mangrove forest, and a salt mine, among other attractions.

Boasting one of the cleanest beaches in Yucatan, where you can swim, sunbathe, walk, or simply admire the beauty. The beach is also known for its spectacular sunsets, as the sea moves back and forms a large sandbar that extends more than 300 meters along the coast.

One of the must-do activities in San Crisanto is to take a boat tour through the mangroves, which are also called the “Venetian Yucatan” because of their beauty and diversity. Along the way, you can see different species of birds, fish, turtles, and even some small swamp lizards. The tour ends at a freshwater spring called Dzonot-Tzik, where you can swim and relax.

Art, Culture and Community Spirit
---------------------------------

The **Village of Dzityá** is located about **10 minutes north** of the **Capital City of Mérida**.

Known for its **stone carving artisanship**, it has a population of about **2,000**. It currently has **two entrances**, one for the road from **Mérida and Progreso** and another from **Francisco de Montejo**.

You will also find **artisan crafts** such as **vases**, **tortillas**, **chandeliers**, **salsa**, **jewelry boxes**, **bases**, **sugar**, **fruits**, and more.

A town founded on **imagination** and **artist creations**, it is a beautiful thing that is **rarely found**.

DISCOVER Colonia Mexico & Campestre

Art, Culture and Community Spirit
---------------------------------

Colonia Mexico is home to a small park, several multicultural restaurants, cafes, businesses, and residential homes.

A neighborhood of great importance in the city, it was born as a project to provide the city with an area where houses could be built for the middle and working classes. In the 1950s, an unprecedented approach to designing domestic space began in Yucatán, driven by the presence of new architecture professionals.

Colonia Mexico, along with the Colonia Alemán, represents the bases of architectural modernism in Yucatán.

The area today known as Fraccionamiento Campestre has its origins in the 1940s. The “Campestre,” translates as countryside or rural. Which is what it was at the time.

The area was originally created upper class as an escape from the hustle and bustle of Mérida.

A large part of Campestre’s appeal was connected with the establishment of the Campestre Country Club in the 1950s.  
Along with a baseball field, tennis courts, and other sports facilities, Club Campestre became known for hosting exclusive social events for Merida's wealthy residents.

As more and more affluent families decided to either move to Fraccionamiento Campestre or build weekend homes, the architecture of the area really began to come into its own and as the area continued to grow, larger and more elaborate homes began to pop up.

However, as Mérida continued to grow, by the 1980s, Fraccionamiento Campestre had lost its rural appeal and had been engulfed by the growth of Mérida.

Explore Cholul
--------------

Like Chuburná, Cholul was once a comisaría with its own local government and ejido land. When henequén production declined, the land became its only valuable asset. With no other industries to sustain them, residents began selling their land in the 1990s to wealthy Meridanos, sparking a wave of development.

Today, Cholul still retains its small, peaceful pueblo charm, centered around a large town square with an old church. The area is uniquely diverse, home to some of Mérida’s richest families, as well as some of its poorest, with a sprinkle of foreign residents adding to the mix.

Cholul is widely regarded as a desirable place to live, offering a tranquil atmosphere with easy access to all the conveniences of Mérida.

Explore Chelem
--------------

Chelem, meaning "Here under the magpie," is one of the most important ports in the municipality, attracting visitors year-round.

Many years ago, Chelem Puerto served as a landing site for cattle, fruits, and other goods transported by canoes from Chiapas and Tabasco. Today, the village is known for its broom-making, fishing, hunting, salt flats, and tourism. Many families from Mérida and beyond have vacation homes in this tropical retreat, surrounded by numerous tourist centers.

Explore Chuburná Puerto
-----------------------

Chuburná Puerto is a picturesque fishing village on the Yucatán coast, just a few miles west of Progreso. With its charm and authenticity, this small town offers visitors a peaceful retreat away from the crowds.

Tranquil Beaches & Scenic Sunsets

The calm coastline is perfect for relaxing, sunbathing, and enjoying the sea breeze. Strolling along the beach at sunset offers one of the most breathtaking natural spectacles in the region.

The soft white sand and turquoise waters provide a serene escape, making Chuburná Puerto an ideal destination for those seeking tranquility by the sea

About this property
-------------------

Casa Tamora is a beautiful, 2-bedroom, 3.5 bathroom, single-level home located in a gated community of Conkal. The community offers to the homeowners a clubhouse, a swimming pool with a lap lane, a gym, a game room, a paddles court, playgrounds, and 24/7 security. The convenience is in this home with a quick access to the main highway and a short drive to the modern amenities that Merida Norte offers. 

Casa Tamora features impressive high ceilings and an open-concept design that integrates the living and dining areas with a stylish kitchen. The social area overlooks the outdoors through the extensive sliding glass doors that bathe the interior with natural light. The kitchen is a sleek with beauty with the custom-made cabinets, a kitchen island and black granite countertops. 

A hallway with an interior garden connects the social living area with the private bedrooms. The principal bedroom features a walk-in closet, a full bathroom and a private garden, while the spacious secondary bedroom boasts an ensuite bathroom and views of the pool. 

  

The central patio features a dipping pool and tasteful landscaping, and an additional full bathroom is adjacent to the service access. Casa Tamora offers ample parking with a carport for two  cars and additional parking for two cars in the driveway.

Explore Chuburna
----------------

Chuburna has a beautiful new main square park where lots of events happen, a state-of-the-art sports complex 2 small grocery stores, pharmacy, fruit and vegetable markets, lots of restaurants with live music. This home is a 5-minute walk to beautiful white sand beaches, 15 minutes to the port town of Progreso that has everything you need, grocery stores, lots of restaurants, world famous Malecon, and the longest pier in the world. Chuburna also is only a 30-minute drive to the historical city of Merida, one of the safest cities in the world.

Explore Chuburna Puerto
-----------------------

Chuburna Puerto offers a lot of fresh food restaurants with a wonderful new town square, and a public pier.   Just minutes’ drive is a huge drive on beach with lots of water sports jet skis, wind surfing, boating etc.  A 15-minute drive will take you to Progreso for shopping, banks, hospital and the world famous Malecon.   Chuburna Puerto is a quick 35 minutes from the historic city of Merida where you will find everything you need, including Costco, Sams, and huge grocery stores.

About this property
-------------------

Welcome to Casa Cascada, a stunning contemporary residence located in a quiet gated community in Conkal, Yucatán. Designed with space and comfort in mind, this home offers an exceptional lifestyle just a short drive from Mérida’s northern conveniences.

Step inside through the inviting foyer and discover a spacious open-concept living area with a large glass wall overlooking the tropical, landscaped pool area, creating a bright and airy ambiance. The modern kitchen is generously sized and ideal for both family living and entertaining. Right off the kitchen, you'll find a huge utility room and a separate large pantry with a sink and second refrigerator, adding to the convenience and functionality.

Casa Cascada features three well-appointed bedrooms, each with its own walk-in closet and ensuite bathroom, ensuring privacy and comfort for every member of the household.  
  
The home does offer first-floor living with a spacious office/flex room and the principal bedroom located on the first floor. The principal bedroom offers ample space for a king-size bed and dresser set, a dream walk-in closet, and a generously sized en suite bathroom with a double vanity, a bathtub, and a glass-enclosed shower. 

The two secondary bedrooms are located on the second floor with a roomy landing that gives space and privacy. Off this landing is an expansive second-floor terrace overlooking the pool area.

  

The home has beautiful finishes that give it a contemporary luxury feel. Home is full of all of the equipment home buyers are looking for, such as solar, water softeners, filtered drinking water, custom window treatments, hot water, air conditioning, and kitchen appliances.

Perfect for enjoying Yucatán’s climate, the property includes a covered terrace that seamlessly connects to a large filtered pool, offering an ideal retreat for relaxation or gatherings.

Located within Entre Parques, residents enjoy the security of a private gated community, numerous amenities, and beautifully maintained surroundings. Just a short drive to Progreso for all shopping needs, banking, hospital, and the famous Malecon.

Explore San Benito
------------------

San Benito is a stretch of beach about 15 minutes’ drive East of the port of Progreso. San Benito is a beautiful beach located in Progreso, Mexico. The beach stretches for over two miles and boasts stunning turquoise waters and soft white sand.

Visitors can enjoy a variety of activities at San Benito, including swimming, sunbathing, fishing, kayaking, and beach volleyball

San Benito include that it is known for its stunning sunsets and is a popular spot for beach weddings. The beach is

also a nesting site for sea turtles, and visitors can observe the turtles’ laying eggs during certain times of the year.

In addition to the beautiful beach, there are several attractions nearby, including the Mayan ruins of Chichen Itza and the Cenote Suytun, a natural swimming hole. Visitors can also enjoy hiking and birdwatching in the nearby mangrove forests.

Explore Baspul
--------------

Baspul, is a community planned and designed with a purpose, where urbanization, nature and architecture get together to create a unique and ideal environment to enjoy family life in large spaces.

To live well is to live in harmony with nature and our environment, is to value our quality of life and our natural resources, is to recover sensations and emotions that make us smile and enjoy life.

In Baspul, we have created scenarios to live unique and unrepeatable moments, creating a more harmonious and evolved lifestyle.

Due to its strategic location at the North of Mérida, Baspul merges the advantages offered by the closeness to the Yucatan capital, Mérida, and the comfort of living in a planned community, designed with every detail to enhance the benefits of the privacy, tranquility, security and comfort offered by our developments with broad spaces, where we raise the quality of life of our families and residents.

All the developments of the Baspul community are characterized by having an intelligent design, where we rescue the elements of local architecture.

Developed in the **1970s** by **architect Félix Mier y Terán Lejeune**, La Ceiba originally had **50 founding members** who shared access to a **golf course, tennis court, pool, and clubhouse**. It was designed as an **exclusive enclave** for those seeking a **tranquil lifestyle** away from the **hustle and bustle of the city**.

About this property
-------------------

Casa Nativa is a contemporary, 2 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom two-story residence located in a gated community of Conkal. This community offers 24/7 security access, green spaces, picnic area, and playground. Homebuyers will find hospitals, malls, grocery stores and more nearby. 

The first floor is complete with an eat-in kitchen, living room, half bathroom, and a guest bedroom with closet and a full bathroom. The interior garden and sliding glass doors bring ample natural light to this space. 

  

Buyers will find relaxation with the mature tropical garden and covered terrace. The second floor features a home office and the principal bedroom with a closet and full bathroom. 

  

Casa Nativa is a fully equipped, turn-key residence with covered parking, mini-split units, pressurized water, 6 solar panels, water softener, appliances and sold furnished.

Explore Chelem
--------------

Chelem, meaning "Here under the magpie," is one of the most important ports in the municipality, attracting visitors year-round.

Many years ago, Chelem Puerto served as a landing site for cattle, fruits, and other goods transported by canoes from Chiapas and Tabasco. Today, the village is known for its broom-making, fishing, hunting, salt flats, and tourism. Many families from Mérida and beyond have vacation homes in this tropical retreat, surrounded by numerous tourist centers.

About this property
-------------------

Casa Marisol is a modern residence located in a cul-de-sac street Conkal. All modern amenities of north Merida are just in a short drive such as hospitals, malls, restaurantes, and more. 

Spanning two spacious floors, this home features a well-thought-out design with 3 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, offering plenty of room for family and guests. As you step inside, you are greeted by a living room and dining area, perfectly designed for entertaining. The heart of the home is its sleek kitchen, boasting a convenient island, custom cabinets and appliances.

  

The first floor also hosts a guest bedroom with full bathroom and closet, ensuring privacy and comfort for your visitors. The seamless integration of indoor and outdoor living is highlighted by sliding doors that open up to the outdoor terrace. A large landscaped patio serves as your personal oasis, ideally paired with a swimming pool that promises endless relaxation under the sunny skies. 

  

Upstairs, the principal bedroom awaits with a walk-in closet and full bath with bathtub, offering a private sanctuary for the homeowners. An additional bedroom with its own bath and closet further enhances the living experience. 

  

Casa Marisol is enhanced with practical amenities such as off-street parking for 3 cars, energy-efficient 11 solar panels, pressurized water system, water softener, mini-split units, and kitchen appliances, ensuring a convenient living experience.

About this property
-------------------

Casa Mary is a modern single story residence located in a quiet gated community in Conkal. This home offers a comfortable living with mini-split units, ceiling fans, pool filtration system, cooktop, custom made cabinets, and plenty of outdoor space.

  

Designed in an L-shape layout that separates the communal social area from the bedrooms. Casa Mary features an open floor plan with high ceilings encompassing the dining room, living room, and kitchen. A hallway that leads to 2 secondary bedrooms with full baths and closets. Passing the secondary bedrooms is the spacious principal bedroom complete with full bath and walk-in closet, with access to the outdoor/pool area. 

  

There is an ample amount of outdoor space complete with a swimming pool, a terrace and patio with grass. 

  

The gated community is conveniently located off the Conkal-Chicxulub highway, just a 15 minute drive to La Isla Mall, 20 to Altabrisa and City Center.

  

Gated community with Clubhouse, gym, semi olympic swimming pool, cafe, paddle courts, and parks. 

HOA Fee: 1500 pesos

About this property
-------------------

This stunning home is located in Altabrisa, the Modern North of Merida.  With its unique design specifically created for the enjoyment of its owners. The connection to the outside terrace and pool area create total isolation from the street, thus maximum privacy and serenity in your private oasis.

The “L” scheme and each space has been endowed with visuals to its multiple terraces providing natural lighting, ventilation and connection to nature.

The architectural design is made up of a social space that integrates the living room, dining room, kitchen and terrace, family room as an articulating space of three bedrooms that connect to multiple terraces and an oratory in the garden area.

Explore Centro
--------------

The city of Mérida was founded by the Spanish conquistadors in the 1540s, on top of a centuries-old Maya city called T'ho.

Mérida was named after Mérida, Spain. It is rumored that the Maya ruins discovered in T'ho reminded the Spanish conquistadors of the Roman ruins of Augusta Emerita.

Over time, the city acquired the nickname "La Ciudad Blanca" (The White City). This may be due to the white limestone used to paint the façades of the colonial buildings.

In some folklore, however, it is thought to originate from the founding Spanish settlers allowing only white-skinned Europeans to live within the city.

Mérida is home to the third-largest old town district (Centro Mérida) on the continent.

About this property
-------------------

Boasting 4 rentals with kitchenettes and a separate main house, it is spectacular property. 

One of the rentals is a separate casita, and the 3 other rentals are housed together in one building with separate entrances. 

The main home has solar, and the property includes a full property generator for the rentals and the main home. 

A park like setting walkways, and sitting areas, and a large soccer field with stadium lighting. 

Smart Home Technology lighting. 

Smart Technology zoned irrigation. 

An amazing pool area, with 2 separates in ground Jacuzzis.  One is heated and the other is for ice.

The pool area also has a heated sauna room.

This gorgeous estate is a quick 7-minute walk to the beach with ocean and river views.   

A 15-minute walk to restaurants and the town of Chelem. 

Property comes with 3 deep wells, off street parking, pressurized water system, large laundry room with sink.

This is truly a unique property, priced to sell and comes fully furnished!

Explore Chelem
--------------

Chelem, meaning "Here under the magpie," is one of the most important ports in the municipality, attracting visitors year-round.

Many years ago, Chelem Puerto served as a landing site for cattle, fruits, and other goods transported by canoes from Chiapas and Tabasco. Today, the village is known for its broom-making, fishing, hunting, salt flats, and tourism. Many families from Mérida and beyond have vacation homes in this tropical retreat, surrounded by numerous tourist centers.

About this property
-------------------

Discover this bright, well-appointed home nestled in one of Conkal's newer gated communities, featuring only 30 homes and providing 24-hour security. This charming residence, merely three years old, boasts a prime location within walking distance to taquerias, restaurants, hardware stores, and local shops. The property offers covered off-street parking for two vehicles and is conveniently situated near a scenic running trail and a delightful bike path.   

In a serene and secluded outdoor haven nestled in a private backyard, you can bask in the opulence of a revitalizing pool and a peaceful covered terrace enveloped by vibrant gardens and lush grass. The expansive outdoor area provides ample space for your pets to frolic. Embrace a sustainable way of life with a multitude of eco-friendly amenities, including 6 solar panels with battery backup, pressurized water, and a biodigester for waste management.   

This idyllic home is just a short 30-minute drive from the beautiful beaches of the Yucatan, 35 minutes from Centro, and 15 minutes from Faro Hospital. The community provides a dog park and a children's playground for the enjoyment of all residents. Monthly fees of 2300 pesos cover community lights, security, and landscaping services.   

The bright and airy kitchen is flooded with natural light and showcases a spacious island with a built-in breakfast bar, ample storage in the pantry, and custom-designed cabinets. It is fully equipped with a 6-burner Whirlpool range and a Whirlpool Double Door Refrigerator, all accentuated by an elegant pasta tile backsplash. The residence consists of 2 well-appointed bedrooms, 3 modern bathrooms, and a conveniently located laundry room. The primary bedroom impresses with its en\-suite bathroom and an expansive walk-in closet, while the secondary bedroom offers versatility to accommodate both a comfortable bed and a fully functional office space, complete with a built-in closet. Furthermore, the property features a spacious living room that opens up to a terrace overlooking a pristine pool area, as well as generously proportioned bathrooms. Additionally, the home boasts the presence of 2 atriums adorned with beautiful gardens, adding a touch of natural serenity to the property.   

The property is equipped with a propane water heater, Starlink and Telmex Fiber connectivity,   Additional amenities include a 120L propane tank, 197 m2 of construction, a fully walled backyard, an open garage, 3 AC units, ceiling fans throughout, 220V electric supply, city water, and a non-filtered pool.  

The home is designed with a double insulated ceiling and features 14-foot ceilings in the living and dining room, while the rest of the house boasts 10-foot ceilings. The property also includes a transferable Fideicomiso Monex.

About this property
-------------------

Casa Alegría is a charming restored colonial home located in Barrio La Ermita and a quick stroll to the Plaza Grande and main market. Preserving its original doors, pasta tiles, high ceilings and colonial beams, this 2 story home is a great place for a permanent or seasonal residency. 

Casa Alegría welcomes with a high ceiling foyer featuring colonial beams and mampostería walls that leads into an eat-in kitchen with island and a lot of storage room with the custom made cabinets. Passing through, there is a living room, full guest bath and a spacious covered terraces facing to the garden and swimming pool.

  

Going up in the embellished pasta tile staircase, there are two spacious bedrooms with closets and ensuite bathrooms. 

  

Location:

\- 4 Blocks to La Ermita Parks

\- 8 Blocks to Main Plaza and Cathedral

\- 12 Blocks to Santa Lucia

Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf Coast is just a short drive away. Most importantly, Merida is considered the safest city in the western hemisphere. Merida is now one of the top destinations for retirement, investment, and living.

About this property
-------------------

Casa Rosita is a charming renovated home that offers a single floor living. Located on a light traffic street, home buyers will find nearby La Ermita park, San Sebastián, San Juan and Plaza Grande.

Chukum finishes, mampostería walls and pasta tile floors embrace the blend of modern and colonial Merida. Features include living room, eat-in kitchen, one bedroom with walk-in closet, full bath, covered terrace, carport, swimming pool and spacious lot.

There is space to built a casita in the back of the property.

  

A perfect opportunity to buy a dream home or a potential investment in the rental market!

Price Fully Furnished: $3,300,000 mxn

\* 3 blocks to Pedro Infante Monument

\* 25 minutes to Merida International Airport

Explore Santiago
----------------

Another of the oldest Colonias in Mérida, the church of Santiago, was founded in 1637. Little remains of the original structure other than a modest sanctuary with a baroque statue of Santiago and a dated inscription at the entry.

Approximately 350-400 years ago, Santiago was the area relegated to the indigenous Indios and artisans. Later it was the German district. Before Paseo de Montejo was built around the turn of the century, Santiago was considered the nicest place to live in Mérida

Explore Merida
--------------

The city of Mérida was founded by the Spanish conquistadors in the 1540s, on top of a centuries-old Maya city called T'ho.

Mérida was named after Mérida, Spain. It is rumored that the Maya ruins discovered in T'ho reminded the Spanish conquistadors of the Roman ruins of Augusta Emerita.

Over time, the city acquired the nickname "La Ciudad Blanca" (The White City). This may be due to the white limestone used to paint the façades of the colonial buildings.

In some folklore, however, it is thought to originate from the founding Spanish settlers allowing only white-skinned Europeans to live within the city.

About this property
-------------------

Casa Secreta is tucked away on a cul de sac and just a quick stroll from the historical charm in main plaza of Cholul. Homebuyers will find an open-air market, restaurants, cafes, pharmacies, and more just a few blocks away from the door.

Upon entering the magnificent foyer, one is greeted by a breathtaking double hight-ceiling, expansive windows, and a charming balcony, all coming together to create an ambiance flooded with natural light and sense of grandiosity.

  

A modern kitchen, complete with a sleek island and a generous pantry that seamlessly face the dining and living room area.

  

This residence extends beyond its interior, revealing an outdoor paradise adorned with an exuberant tropical garden, a sunbath area, swimming pool, and an open-air terrace designed for moments of tranquility or entertainment.

  

Casa Secreta’s charm continues to a pair of twin casitas, each boasting a full bath, walk-in closets and tranquil interior gardens, presenting versatile space for guests accommodations.

  

On the second floor, a generous master suite, complete with a full bath and walk-in closet of dreams, ensuring a private heaven of comfort. A flexible bonus room offers the potential to serve as a TV room, office, or a fourth bedroom, catering to varying lifestyles and needs.

  

A sanctuary of beauty and elegance in the north of Merida.

  

Art, furniture and appliance are for sale separately.

About this property
-------------------

Casa Carlota is a two-story residence located in Cholul. Situated just 4 blocks away from the main plaza, the homeowners will find several cafes, restaurants, market, and much more within walking distance. 

This home has an open concept design that connects the foyer with its double high ceilings to the living room, dining room, and equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar.

This home is the perfect size for the retirees looking to live there full-time or part-time. Casa Carlota offers balanced indoor and outdoor spaces for entertaining, including a covered terrace, swimming pool, greenery, and a BBQ area.  

  

All 3 bedrooms with ensuite bathroom and closet are located on the second floor. The service room functions as a storage/walk-in pantry with a laundry room.

Merida, Yucatan is a vibrant historic city best known as the cultural capital of Latin America. Ancient Maya cities, stunning cenotes and majestic haciendas dot the countryside of the Yucatan. Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf Coast is just a short drive away. Most importantly, Merida is considered the safest city in the western hemisphere. Merida is now one of the top destinations for retirement, investment, and living.

About this property
-------------------

Nestled in Centro Mérida, this beautifully updated home offers the perfect blend of modern comfort, sustainable living, and timeless Yucatecan charm. Just steps away from vibrant plazas, local markets, and world class dining, the location is as convenient as it is cultural.

Inside, thoughtful upgrades ensure peace of mind and effortless living. All new aluminum windows and doors with screens welcome breezes while keeping the home cool and bright. Energy efficient inverter air conditioners and 16 solar panels deliver comfort with sustainability in mind. A pressurized water system, water softener, reverse osmosis drinking water, and a new 130L hot water heater ensure everyday ease.

The interiors are elevated by custom Tzalam cabinetry and furniture, complemented by brand new appliances including a French door refrigerator and combination washer/dryer. New ceiling fans circulate the air throughout, while the freshly sealed roof with 7 layer epoxy, mesh, and impermeable coating adds long-term security. Completely new electric and plumbing systems, including a biodigester, provide worry free functionality.

Outdoors, a Green Egg style chargrill smoker/barbecue invites leisurely afternoons and festive gatherings with friends.

Offered turn-key furnished (excluding the owner’s personal items and select artwork), this residence is truly move in ready. Whether enjoyed as a full time home, a vacation retreat, or an investment property, it offers an exceptional opportunity to experience the best of Centro living in Mérida.

Merida, Yucatan is a vibrant historic city best known as the cultural capital of Latin America. Ancient Maya cities, stunning cenotes and majestic haciendas dot the countryside of the Yucatan. Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf Coast is just a short drive away. Most importantly, Merida is considered the safest city in the western hemisphere. Merida is now one of the top destinations for retirement, investment, and living.

Featuring a wide facade, pasta tile floors, mampostería walls and good bone structure, this is a great opportunity to buy a blank canvas and make it your dream home.

  

The property has an assumable fideicomiso with Monex bank.

About this property
-------------------

Casa Arcos is one of the homes where you will fall in love with the moment you step in, with the original pasta tile floors, colonial high ceilings, traditional wooden doors, and elegant arches. You'll be embraced by the classic Yucatecan colonial charm of this stunning, single-level residence situated in the convenient Barrio San Juan.

  

The layout offers a warm welcome with a foyer, 3 spacious bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms, and an anteroom that connects to well-defined social areas overlooking the large filtered pool. One of the highlights of Casa Arcos is the centrally located swimming pool with a tiled floor, an open terrace and mamposteria walls, which create an ambiance ideal for entertaining and relaxation. 

  

Located in Barrio San Juan, Casa Arcos is within walking distance of Plaza Grande, Catedral, San Sebastián, La Ermita, Santiago, and Santa Lucía. Homeowners are minutes away from restaurants, cafes, shops, and more. 

Casa Arcos is a truly special property that combines beauty, comfort, and history. 

  

  

Merida, Yucatan is a vibrant historic city best known as the cultural capital of Latin America. Ancient Maya cities, stunning cenotes and majestic haciendas dot the countryside of the Yucatan. Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf of Mexico is just a short drive away. Most importantly, Merida is considered one of the safest cities in the western hemisphere. Merida is now one of the top destinations for retirement, investment, and living.

About this property
-------------------

Located just two blocks from Chedraui Itzaes, Casa Tony offers flexible living and income potential with two living spaces.

The main house still has the original living space that contains three rooms and an unfinished carport. On the second floor is a renovated apartment with a kitchenette and two bedrooms with a closet and full baths. The largest of the two bedrooms has a private terrace.

  

In the middle of the property is a sizable pool with a terrace.  
  
In the rear of the property is a newly renovated casita with living room, kitchen, laundry, bedroom and full bath. Behind the casita is a large garden.

  

The property is sold with furniture, appliances and air conditioning. Fantastic opportunity for living full time and earning extra income.

About this property
-------------------

Casa San. Apóstol is a completely new colonial home located in Barrio San Sebastian.  
  
The spacious home features 16 ft ceilings, pasta tile/polished cement floors, marble countertops and 10 ft custom doors. The living space encompasses a large open-concept room, 3 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms and a covered patio facing an “L” shaped pool and garden.  
  
Casa San. Apóstol is located in the centro historico of Merida near restaurants, shops, markets and museums, and just 10 minutes from the airport and hospitals.  
  
This elegant home is perfect for year round or part-time living.

Explore Merida
--------------

Merida, Yucatan is a vibrant historic city best known as the cultural capital of Latin America. Ancient Maya cities, stunning cenotes and majestic haciendas dot the countryside of the Yucatan. Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf Coast is just a short drive away. Most importantly, Merida is considered the safest city in the western hemisphere. Merida is now one of the top destinations for retirement, investment, and living.

About this property
-------------------

Hacienda Encantada is a charming, restored 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom colonial gem located in Chuminopolis. This neighborhood is in the eastern part of centro, a historic area named after one of its founders “Ciudad de Domingo”. Just on a short walk from the landmarks of the area: 3 blocks to El Recuerdo Church, 4 blocks to Plaza Patio, 9 blocks to Chem Bech market and 11 blocks from La Plancha Park. 

Hacienda Encantada was once part of a large Hacienda founded over 100 years ago know for raising livestocks for the local community. Now the home offers all the traditional Yucatecan charm of the original pasta tile floors, mampostería walls, and restored doors. Featuring a centrally located kitchen with island, spacious living room, and cozy dining area.

Outside, you will find an urban oasis complete with a covered terrace, swimming pool, and lush tropical garden, creating an inviting, peaceful retreat. 

This beautiful single floor living home presents a bonus loft-style area with a perfect space for a home office and a bunk bed for the guests.

25 minutes to Merida International Airport

45 minutes to Gulf of Mexico

About this property
-------------------

With endless possibilities, this Mid-Century home located in Lourdes awaits for the new homeowners to reinvente the spaces.

 Situated just 5 blocks to Chem Bech Market, 8 blocks to La Mejorada Park, 13 Blocks to La Plancha and 14 Blocks to Plaza Grande, the home offers many amenities within walking distance.

  

With 442m²  of construction, the versatile layout is impressive offering multiple living areas, several bedrooms, and spacious bathrooms, all ready for your design vision. At the back, an existing covered patio and private outdoor space offer space to create a lounging area, garden and swimming pool.

  

Strong bones, generous dimensions, and plenty of character– bring your plans and imagine what this property can become.

About this property
-------------------

This is an affordable starter home for any buyer with a friendly budget that is looking for a home in the centro area. Casa Aguamarina is located in the Lourdes area situating the buyers within 6 blocks of Chen Bech Market, 7 blocks of Mercado San Benito and 10 blocks of La Mejorada Park. 

Casa Aguamarina is a 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom charming home that preserves original pasta tile floors, colonial beams and high ceilings. It has a living room, dining room, kitchen, and landscaped garden with a dipping pool. 

  

This property has a lien with BBVA (+/- 900,000 pesos).

About this property
-------------------

Casa Tropical is a 3 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom, modern two-story residence located on a quiet street in the charming neighborhood of Miguel Aleman. Homebuyers will find walkability to Aleman Market, park, grocery stores, pharmacy, and restaurants from the door. Miguel Aleman was one of the first planned mid-century neighborhoods characterized by the orientation of the houses and tree-lined avenues. The popular Aleman Park is an attractive place for the local families with a small fair, snack carts, skating board rink and is pet friendly.This beautiful double lot home welcomes the homeowners with a front garden that invites them to discover the beauty inside. Casa Tropical integrates the spacious living room, dining room and equipped kitchen on the first floor, the perfect setting for cozy evenings… [Read More](https://yucatanbeachandcityproperties.com/casa-tropical-two-story-modern-residence-in-miguel-aleman-double-lot/#)
or entertaining guests. The equipped kitchen offers ample storage space with the custom cabinetry and built-in pantry complete with a center island. The expansive patio presents an ample amount of entertaining and relaxing area with a large swimming pool, a grilling area, picturesque landscaping and a charming covered terrace. A well-designed staircase with beautiful iron railings leads to the spacious master bedroom with en-suite bathroom, walk-in closet and private terrace. Additionally, there are two good sized guest bedrooms and a full bathroom. Casa Tropical offers room to expand the construction with an adjacent casita or independent apartment. About this property
-------------------

Welcome to this beautifully appointed and fully equipped residence offering comfort, space, and style in one of Mérida’s desirable neighborhoods.

Casa Urbana features three secondary bedrooms each with full bathrooms and closets. The fourth bedroom is a grand principal suite with a walk-in closet, spa tub, shower and sitting area. 

  

The equipped kitchen with a breakfast nook is perfect for everyday living, while the generous living room, dedicated office, and inviting foyer create a warm and functional flow throughout the home.

  

Outdoors, enjoy a sparkling filtered pool, and entertain guests at the terrace with a bar, and ample space. Easy access is offered with parking for up to four vehicles and located on a quiet street just off one of Merida’s main tree-lined avenues. All New Modern conveniences include air conditioning, pressurized water system, reverse osmosis and a water softener, ensuring year-round comfort. Property includes ALL NEW Appliances in the kitchen.

  

Perfect for families or those seeking a stylish and comfortable retreat, this home blends thoughtful design with practical features in a prime location.

  

Merida, Yucatan is a vibrant historic city best known as the cultural capital of Latin America. Ancient Maya cities, stunning cenotes and majestic haciendas dot the countryside of the Yucatan. Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf Coast is just a short drive away. Most importantly, Merida is considered the safest city in the western hemisphere. Merida is now one of the top destinations for retirement, investment, and living.

Investment Opportunity in García Ginerés – 3BR/3BA Home with Tremendous Potential

Located on a quiet, low traffic street in the highly desirable neighborhood of García Ginerés, Casa Garcia is a 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home that is the perfect opportunity for investors,  or anyone looking to build some equity in one of Mérida’s most charming areas.

Set on a generous lot, Casa Garcia offers a solid structure, beautiful local stone details, and an ideal layout — but is in need of updates and repairs. With some vision and work, this property could become a stunning residence.

✨ Property Features:

*   3 spacious bedrooms, each with its own full bathroom and closey  
      
    
*   Generous living and dining areas with natural light  
      
    
*   Secure parking and gated entry  
      
    
*   Quiet, wide street just minutes from Parque de las Américas, local cafés, and hospitals  
      
    

🔧 Deferred Maintenance – Priced Accordingly

This home requires work (roof sealed, paint, general cleanup), but offers significant upside potential in a neighborhood where renovated homes command top market value.

💡 Whether you’re an investor seeking your next project or a buyer wanting to create your dream home in a prime location, this is a rare chance to buy low and build equity in one of Mérida’s most sought-after areas.

📍 Location: García Ginerés, Mérida – central, tranquil, and full of character

About this property
-------------------

Casa Umbral is a spectacular, architecturally designed residence located in Barrio Santiago.

The impressive home features a full garage, entry garden with pond, equipment bodega, laundry room, fully equipped kitchen, impressive double high ceiling open concept living space, two spacious bedrooms, 2 walk-in closets, 2.5 baths, filtered swimming pool and terrace.

  

Casa Umbral combines textures and natural light to form a warm and inviting living space that will impress all your guests. The home is not just about design, it will please any homebuyer with its functionality and ample storage found throughout the home.

About this property
-------------------

Casa Las Amigas, a beautiful colonial home nestled in Barrio Santiago. Designed by Merida Office of Design and Architecture (MODA), this two story home offers the perfect blend of historical charm and modern comfort, making it an ideal residence for those seeking a tranquil urban oasis. 

With an open concept design and inviting ambiance, this home welcomes with a colonial beamed high ceiling living room, dining room, equipped kitchen, guest bath and indoor garden that brings nature and breeze to the house. 

A swimming pool and terrace is in the heart of Casa Las Amigas. This serene spot is designed for relaxation and entertainment, offering a perfect escape  from the warm days of the city.  

  

Casa Las Amigas features two bedrooms each with a full bath and closet.

Barrio Santiago is one of the most sought-after areas in Centro. Full of culture and culinary experiences, homebuyers will find many conveniences all within walking distance such as grocery stores, Mercado Santiago, coffee shops, boutique stores and much more.

Sold fully furnished, Casa Las Amigas Stans as an extraordinary opportunity for those looking for a permanent residence, a temporal retreat, or an investment property in Merida Centro.

Explore Merida
--------------

Merida, Yucatan is a vibrant historic city best known as the cultural capital of Latin America. Ancient Maya cities, stunning cenotes and majestic haciendas dot the countryside of the Yucatan. Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf Coast is just a short drive away. Most importantly, Merida is considered the safest city in the western hemisphere. Merida is now one of the top destinations for retirement, investment, and living.

About this property
-------------------

Casa 562 Hache is a successful AirBNB investment featuring  2 bedrooms and  2 full bathrooms. The home offers a chic and tropical atmosphere with its various lust gardens and clean contemporary design.  

Casa 562 Hache comes fully equipped and ready to rent including all furniture and home items. In the heart of the property is a dipping pool with water feature terrace and outdoor shower. 

Situated on Calle 47, the property is a 20 minute walk to Santa Ana park where tenants can find the Gastronomy Zone, Calle 60 and much more! Cafes such as Galerón, Amelia and Estación 74 are located less than a ten minute walk from Casa 562 Hache.

Casa 562 Hache is the perfect investment property or perfect for a single person looking for an affordable place to call home.

About this property
-------------------

This is a WOW home! Casa Colina exudes the grandeur of the traditional colonial with modern comforts in a single living space. This hidden gem is located in the Barrio San Cristobal. 

Boasting three generously sized bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom for maximum privacy and comfort. Within the main house, two of the bedrooms serve as serene retreats, while the third retreat is located at the rear of the property and boast a private portico-style terrace, perfect for enjoying morning coffee. 

  

Featuring expansive living spaces with high ceilings, abundant natural light and picturesque painted walls, Casa Colina welcomes with a foyer that invites to the social areas through a peaceful, landscaped central courtyard and stone wall fountain. The main social areas are seamlessly integrated into an open concept design.

  

The heart of Casa Colina lies in its spectacular outdoor oasis. A large swimming pool acts as the centerpiece connecting the main house and the casita, surrounded by a sun deck and grill areas, providing unforgettable moments of relaxation and entertaining in your own tropical paradise.

About this property
-------------------

Welcome to Casa Colorida, a vibrant single-floor colonial gem nestled in the sought-after Santa Ana neighborhood. This exquisite residence places the homeowners blocks away to Paseo Montejo, Santa Ana Park, and La Plancha Park. Embrace the convenience of city life with a multitude of cafes, art galleries, and fine dining options right at your doorstep.

  

Skilled craftsmanship is evident in the detailed colorful painted walls, pasta tile floors, artificially crafted beams, high ceilings and abundant skylights, ensuring every corner of this residence is bathed in natural light.

The principal bedroom is a sanctuary of peace that overlooks to the landscaped garden, and boasting an ensuite bath with a bathtub.

  

The allure of Casa Colorida extends to its exterior, where a verdant garden, inviting swimming pool, and covered terrace awaits to host your leisure and entertainment.  To extend the outdoor living space, the exterior features a staircase the leads to a covered, rooftop terrace.

  

Embark on your next chapter in this exquisite home, where the vibrancy of urban life and the tranquility of a private oasis coalesce.

About this property
-------------------

This stunning remodeled colonial in Santiago features a modern brutalist expansion and a well appointed chef’s kitchen.

  

Located near Parque la Paz and Parque Centenario, this bright and spacious home is a standout.  
  
The open plan chef’s kitchen features an appliance center complete with electrical outlets, a unique two sided pantry that opens to easily access all of your ingredients, a Smeg stove, an Italian granite sink with brass fixtures, a six stage reverse osmosis water filter, dishwasher connections and a french door refrigerator. The masonry work throughout is stunning and warm, including the beeswax polished countertops in the kitchen and on the large central island suitable for dining.  
  
Each of the 3 bedrooms is situated to provide privacy and comfort. The large principal suite on the second floor is a contemporary brutalist addition providing luxury and privacy for the residents. The principal bath features double sinks and a glass ceiling shower with double sprays. Adjacent to this suite, you’ll enjoy the large roof terrace and the private balcony overlooking the sparkling pool.

  

The filtered pool features a waterfall and a one of a kind terraced wall. An outdoor shower and bath will make entertaining poolside effortless.

  

This unique home has beautiful natural light, high ceilings, organic finishes, tasteful and abundant cabinetry and beautiful

pasta tile floors.

About this property
-------------------

Casa Deco is situated in the popular area of centro. Just 2 blocks to 47 Gastronomy row and 4 blocks to Santa Ana, Santa Lucia and Parque La Plancha. The future homeowners will find the best of centro just all within a short walking distance from their front door.

  

The home features much of its original charm from when it was constructed in 1932 with the original art deco style pasta tile floors, arches, doors, windows, iron work. The home has stood strong for nearly a century with its thick mamposteria walls and iron beamed ceilings. 

  

The home offers many charming and cozy spaces with 3 bedrooms, living room, foyer, studio, courtyard, eat-in kitchen, 2 full baths and rear garden with filtered pool.  

  

Casa Deco is sold with appliances and furnished.

About this property
-------------------

From the moment you step in, the blend of chic elegance, modern comfort and a neutral palette with Chukum finishes invite you to take a look at Casa Natura. This urban tropical oasis is located just 4.5 blocks away from Barrio Santiago, situating the homeowners within walking distance to grocery stores, fresh produce, cafes and much more.

This spectacular contemporary residence is designed to offer privacy and comfort ambiance with the potential of income in the rental market with a fully independent two story casita in the front and a main house at the rear connected in the heart by the serene swimming pool and greenery. 

  

Iron glass doors and windows provide breezes and tons of natural light, the casita integrates two apartments with an elegant open layout design. The downstairs unit features a spacious bedroom that faces the central patio, Tzalam wood deck, and the swimming pool complete with full bathroom, fully equipped kitchen, living and dining areas. Upstairs is a 1 bedroom, 1 full bathroom complete with a private terrace, kitchenette, living and dining area. 

  

The stunning 2 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom main house flanked by arches welcomes another open concept living space which encompasses the living room, dining room, half bath, and equipped kitchen complete with custom made cabinets and a terrazzo island. At the rear is the large utility room containing all the home equipment, laundry room and space for storage. 

  

On the second level is the retreat for the homeowner with a spacious bedroom, large custom made closet and a full bathroom with double vanity and Castel bathtub. Additionally there is a guest bedroom, built-in shelving and a full bathroom. 

  

Casa Natura is a turnkey residence. This home is fully equipped with 8 solar panels, water softener, pressurized water, pool filtration system, 6 stage water filters, air conditioning units, and high-end appliances.

About this property
-------------------

Casa Lazuli is a restored home that combines Colonial architecture with contemporary finishes such as pigmented concrete, Chukum and modern pasta tiles. San Sebastian’s charming neighborhood provides convenience for homebuyers with the San Sebastian Park, La Ermita, and Chedraui Itzáes all within walking distance.

  

Preserving its colonial elements, Casa Lazuli boasts a spacious living room with high ceilings and original colonial beams. The pasta tile walkway continues to all the areas home from the front door to the rear casita.

  

A guest bedroom with full bath is located just outside the living room access from the first courtyard. Its sliding glass door captures the breeze and natural light.

  

The equipped eat-in kitchen is centrally located between the two courtyards creating a great hangout place when entertaining friends.

  

At the rear of the property, there is a second bedroom with a closet and full bath.  From this room and the kitchen, the homeowners will have views of the adorable ochre-colored swimming pool area.

  

Casa Lazuli is prepped for pool filtration, and a/c unit installation.

About this property
-------------------

Casa Heliconia, Immaculate and Stylish Two Story Residence in San Sebastián

Discover Casa Heliconia, a beautiful and stylish residence located in Barrio San Sebastián. The owners will find 1.5 blocks to San Sebastián Park, 4.5 blocks to La Ermita, grocery stores, and more nearby. 

  

The sleek beauty is admirable in the moment that you step inside with crema Maya floors, high ceilings, custom cabinetry and iron work throughout the property. 

  

This 2 bedroom, 2.5 bath offers an open concept design that integrates the living room, dining room and the equipped kitchen overlooking the tropical outdoor space. 

  

Complete with imported granite countertops, an island, ample storage space with custom cabinets and appliances that fit in the space, the kitchen is a dream for the homeowners who enjoy cooking.

  

Between the main house and the two-story casita is the beautiful outdoor space with a heated, filtered swimming pool, and a green wall. The casita offers two equal sized bedrooms each one with its own full bathroom and built-in closets.

About this property
-------------------

Welcome Casa Arborea, a stunning contemporary residence located in a beautiful gated community located in Conkal, Yucatán. Designed with elegance and comfort in mind, this home offers an exceptional lifestyle just minutes from Mérida’s northern conveniences.

Step inside through the inviting foyer and discover a spacious open-concept living area with soaring double-height ceilings, creating a bright and airy ambiance. The modern kitchen is generously sized and ideal for both family living and entertaining. A utility room right off the kitchen adds convenience and functionality.

Casa Arborea features three well-appointed bedrooms, each with its own walk-in closet and ensuite bathroom, ensuring privacy and comfort for every member of the household.

Perfect for enjoying Yucatán’s climate, the property includes an enclosed terrace that seamlessly connects to a large filtered pool, offering an ideal retreat for relaxation or gatherings.

Merida, Yucatan is a vibrant historic city best known as the cultural capital of Latin America. Ancient Maya cities, stunning cenotes and majestic haciendas dot the countryside of the Yucatan. Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf Coast is just a short drive away. Most importantly, Merida is considered the safest city in the western hemisphere. Merida is now one of the top destinations for retirement, investment, and living.

About this property
-------------------

Casa K’iin is a spacious single floor contemporary home located in a quiet, yet convenient area of Merida north. Homebuyers will find the location perfect for full time living with being just minutes away from shopping in Las Americas, 10 minutes from shopping in the north side of Merida and only 30 minutes to the Gulf of Mexico  
  
This fully modernized home has everything for you to check in your boxes: 15 solar panels, water softener, pool with filtration system, pressurized water, internet, mini-split units, two car garage with automatic door and single level!

The home has two generous sized secondary bedrooms each with their own walk-in closet and full bathroom. In the rear of the property is the roomy principal bedroom with its large walk-in closet, sizable vanity and full bath. All the bedrooms open up the pool area with sliding glass doors that provide each space with ample natural light. All the rooms face north to maximize the breeze!

15 minutes to the Harbor Mall, Costo, and Galerías

30 minutes to Gulf of Mexico 

25 minutes to Merida Centro

Merida, Yucatan is a vibrant historic city best known as the cultural capital of Latin America. Ancient Maya cities, stunning cenotes and majestic haciendas dot the countryside of the Yucatan. Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf Coast is just a short drive away. Most importantly, Merida is considered the safest city in the western hemisphere. Merida is now one of the top destinations for retirement, investment, and living.

About this property
-------------------

### Your Coastal Sanctuary Awaits in San Benito

Discover the pinnacle of beachfront living in this exclusive residential development on the stunning Yucatan coast. Perfectly situated at km 24.5 of the Progreso–Telchac highway, this property seamlessly blends privacy, modern comfort, and breathtaking ocean views.

Step into a sun-drenched living space that opens through floor-to-ceiling glass onto a spacious wrap-around balcony, offering panoramic views of the turquoise waters and the perfect setting for sunset cocktails. This 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom residence is being offered fully furnished and turnkey, featuring a gourmet kitchen and high-end finishes throughout. The master suite serves as a true retreat, boasting its own private balcony for quiet mornings overlooking the Gulf. This property would make an excellent Airbnb.

Designed for peace of mind, the unit is equipped with full hurricane shutters, climate control, and a backup power generator.

### The Experience:

*   Exclusive Amenities: Enjoy direct beach access, two sparkling pools, a designer sun deck, and an adult social bar.
    
*   Wellness & Productivity: Stay active in the private, fully equipped gym, and handle business with ease at the dedicated Work Center.
    
*   Family & Entertainment: Includes a Kids Club, Cinema Club, and a game room for residents.
    
*   Unmatched Security: 24/7 surveillance and perimeter fencing integrated with native Chaká trees.

About this property
-------------------

Nestled in the heart of the Chem Bech area, this beautiful, newly renovated single-level home offers a quiet location and walking distance to the Chembech market zone.

Casa Chembech features 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms across 195 square meters of interior space, this home was designed to offer a harmonious balance of comfort and style. Blending a rustic traditional charm with modern comfort, features mampostería walls, wooden doors, and original pasta tile floor combined with polished cement floors and Chukum finishes. 

  
The outdoor space is a serene oasis for entertaining and relaxation with a swimming pool at the rear, greenery areas and a large covered terrace with a palapa.  
  

Casa Chembech offers buyers an affordable Turn-Key home with all furniture, art and home items included. Don’t pass up this opportunity to make your new home in the up and coming area of east centro. 

  

Merida, Yucatan is a vibrant historic city best known as the cultural capital of Latin America. Ancient Maya cities, stunning cenotes and majestic haciendas dot the countryside of the Yucatan. Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf Coast is just a short drive away. Most importantly, Merida is considered the safest city in the western hemisphere. Merida is now one of the top destinations for retirement, investment, and living.

About this property
-------------------

Step from Your Terrace to the Sand in Beautiful Chelem 

Experience the pinnacle of coastal living in this stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom beachfront sanctuary. Designed for those who appreciate the rhythm of the ocean, this condo offers an expansive living space that blurs the line between indoors and out. 

The heart of this home is the oversized beachfront terrace—your front-row seat to the emerald waters of the Gulf. Inside, the open-concept layout provides a bright, airy atmosphere perfect for entertaining. The primary suite serves as a private retreat, featuring a spacious ensuite bath and premium finishes. 

Modern Conveniences Forget the "rustic" beach struggles; this condo is built for comfort. Enjoy the luxury of a soft water system throughout the home. Your vehicle stays secure in the 1-car garage with an electric opener, and your beach gear stays organized in your private, individual storage bodega. 

Community & Location Relax by the sparkling community pool or soak up the sun on the expansive deck. Located just a short distance from the vibrant heart of Chelem, you are minutes away from local seafood, markets, and the authentic Yucatecan charm that makes this town so beloved.

Merida, Yucatan is a vibrant historic city best known as the cultural capital of Latin America. Ancient Maya cities, stunning cenotes and majestic haciendas dot the countryside of the Yucatan. Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf Coast is just a short drive away. Most importantly, Merida is considered the safest city in the western hemisphere. Merida is now one of the top destinations for retirement, investment, and living.

3 Bedrooms | 3.5 Bathrooms | Short Walk to the Beach 

Discover the perfect coastal lifestyle in this custom-built home located in the highly sought-after community of Chuburná, Yucatán.  Turnkey, fully furnished home Situated on a large, oversized lot, this property offers a rare amount of outdoor space and privacy, all while being just a short walk from the pristine beach. 

Key Property Features 

Modern Open Concept: The heart of the home features a seamless, open-concept layout connecting the kitchen, dining, and living areas. This airy design maximizes natural light and creates an inviting space for entertaining. 

Gourmet Kitchen: Beautifully designed with custom cabinetry and a breakfast bar, perfect for casual meals or hosting guests. 

The Master Suite: A spacious upstairs retreat featuring a full ensuite bath and a walk-in closet. Two private balconies offer elevated views—one overlooking the sparkling pool and the lush yard. 

Outdoor Oasis: Step out to a large covered terrace that leads to an oversized filtered pool and a sprawling yard, offering endless possibilities for gardening, lounging, or future expansion. 

Rare Garage & Security: Includes a one-car garage (or project workshop) with a washer-dryer and an electric gate opener—a highly prized feature for vehicle protection and storage in coastal areas.

Explore Merida
--------------

Merida, Yucatan is a vibrant historic city best known as the cultural capital of Latin America. Ancient Maya cities, stunning cenotes and majestic haciendas dot the countryside of the Yucatan. Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf Coast is just a short drive away. Most importantly, Merida is considered the safest city in the western hemisphere. Merida is now one of the top destinations for retirement, investment, and living.

A one-of-a-kind home with all the upgrades and famous Mexican arched doorways.  
  
The pool area is fantastic with 2 large covered sitting areas and incredible landscaping, only a 3-minute walk to beach.  
  
Home has a very spacious open floor plan with indoor kitchen and out door kitchen.  
  
20-minute drive to Progreso where you will find 4 major grocery stores, banks, hospital and world famous Malecon boardwalk.  
  
30-minute drive to the historical city of Merida where you will find world class shopping malls, professional sports, ice skating rink, movie theaters etc.  
  
Chelem is a quite beach town with many restaurants, 2 small grocery stores and doctors. Chelem is known for community events. a fun place to live.  
  
This is the most popular beach town in the area.  
  
Fully furnished, this home is full of charm.
