About this property
-------------------

Discover Your Dream Beach Home in the Yucatan

Casa Arena provides future homeowners modern coastal living at its finest with a fully equipped single-level property, situated just a short block from the beach in Chelem. This beautifully walled residence features front access, a secure remote-controlled aluminum electric gate, and rear access perfect for home and pool maintenance. Peace of mind is provided with the advanced alarm system, and perimeter cameras for your peace of mind.

  

The 2 bedroom main house offers a principal bedroom with its own ensuite bathroom, plus an additional full bath and secondary bedroom for guests. In addition, a charming casita at the back of the property includes 1 bedroom and 1 full bath, making it a private space for visitors.

  

Fully furnished and move-in ready, this home boasts a well-equipped kitchen complete with a dishwasher, along with custom built-in cabinetry throughout. You’ll also find a convenient indoor laundry room equipped with a washer and dryer.

  

Step outside to enjoy beautifully landscaped gardens featuring fruit trees, all maintained by an automated sprinkler system. The backyard is a true oasis, featuring a stunning swimming pool complete with UV filtration, a robotic cleaner, and an efficient passive heating system.

  

Enjoy superior water quality throughout the home, with a pressurized and UV-filtered system, and a drinkable Reverse Osmosis/UV setup in the kitchen. The property is equipped with city water services, supplemented by an on-site filtered well for extra convenience.

  

For energy efficiency, this home boasts 16 solar panels coupled with an automatic 2 Lithium  battery backup system and an outdoor generator input, ensuring power stability and self- sufficiency—yielding low or even no electric bills!

  

Don’t miss out on this incredible opportunity to own a piece of paradise. This beach house is ready for you to call home.

About this property
-------------------

Welcome to a serene and spacious residence located in the peaceful community of Residential Baspul, just minutes from the charming town of Chicxulub and a short drive from both the Gulf Coast beaches and the vibrant city of Mérida. This area is known for its privacy, tranquility, and natural surroundings, offering homeowners a perfect balance between comfort, convenience, and a connection to nature.

This beautiful single-story Mexican-style home is designed for families, remote professionals, and anyone seeking a versatile property with generous indoor and outdoor living spaces. With high ceilings, lush vegetation, mature fruit trees, and a spectacular pool and terrace area, the home provides a refreshing, hacienda-inspired atmosphere. Independent work and recreation spaces add even more flexibility, making this property ideal for home-based businesses, creative studios, or wellness activities.

About this property
-------------------

Welcome to your dream beach retreat at this charming abode, perfectly positioned on a tranquil street in serene Chelem, Progreso Yucatan. Constructed in 2020, this two-story haven blends modern conveniences with traditional aesthetics, offering a peaceful sanctuary just a 3-minute stroll from the beach. Encompassing a lot size of 197 m2 with a cozy 69 m2 of living space, this home is a jewel waiting to be discovered.

As you step through the fully walled perimeter, you're greeted by an oasis of calm and privacy. The home itself features two bedrooms, each equipped with air conditioning for your utmost comfort. The large bedroom on the main level offers easy access to the pool and outdoor areas, inviting in the fresh ocean breezes through expansive windows that also fill the home with natural light.

The heart of this residence is undoubtedly its vibrant outdoor living spaces. A filtered pool promises endless fun under the sun, while the outdoor kitchen, adorned with gorgeous pasta tile, beckons for al fresco dining. An outdoor shower adds to the convenience, ensuring a seamless transition from beach to relaxation. The large upstairs balcony is a haven for soaking in the ocean breezes and views, making every moment at home feel like a vacation.

  

Practical features include off-street parking for two vehicles, pressurized water, and outside storage. The home is also fully equipped for immediate enjoyment, boasting a cooktop, refrigerator, washing machine, air fryer, and convection oven. The delightful use of Talavera sinks and a pasta tile accent wall infuses the space with local charm and character, mirroring the beauty of its surroundings.

  

Situated just 5 minutes from Chelem Centro, with a tienda and restaurants nearby, this home offers both the tranquility of a beachside escape and the convenience of city amenities. The easy-to-maintain talavera tile throughout ensures that your focus remains on the joys of coastal living.

  

This beach home, with its blend of modern features and traditional touches, is an idyllic setting for making lasting memories. Whether you're basking in the privacy of your walled garden, entertaining friends by the pool, or enjoying the nearby beach and community, this Chelem retreat promises a lifestyle of relaxation and adventure. Discover the charm and ease of beachside living in the Yucatan, and make this exquisite property your own.

About this property
-------------------

Welcome to your New Custom-Built, Architecturally Designed Home located in Chuburna Puerto.  This One-of-a-Kind Resort Style Home was completed in 2022, offering water views, multiple balconies, decks, and covered terraces.  Enjoy the expansive outdoor entertainment area with an outdoor kitchen, lounge areas and a unique pool with a water feature.  Located on a double lot so there is plenty of space for your pets to play or host a cornhole tournament.  

The main floor has a half bath conveniently located near the entertainment area for guests as well as a full bath just off the pool.  The open floor plan allows guests to mingle throughout the main floor and the outdoor space. 

This fully furnished home offers a chef's kitchen with gorgeous marble countertops, a walk-in pantry,  French door refrigerator, an 8-burner gas range, custom wood cabinets and a dishwasher as a bonus! 

This home boasts a Rare, enclosed garage with a large full bathroom.  The garage could easily be converted to a large main floor primary bedroom. 

Upstairs, you will find the large primary bedroom with a walk-through shower and a walk-in closet.   The large secondary bedroom offers ample closet space and an ensuite bathroom. 

This home offers all the necessary systems, including a Generac backup generator (propane), 10 solar panels (540 watts each), reverse osmosis drinking water in the kitchen, water filter and softener, and a filtered pool.

About this property
-------------------

If you're looking to live in Progreso, just a few blocks from the Boulevard Touristico malecon you'll be close to a variety of amenities, including restaurants, supermarkets, schools, hospitals, banks, pharmacies, and a local market. 

Experience the tranquility of beach living with this ideal property. This residence can also serve as a source of income if you're interested in renting it out. 

The main house is substantial, and situated on the ground floor is a living room, dining room, kitchen, pantry, a half bathroom, a covered terrace, and off-street parking that accommodates one car. On the upper floor, you'll find a spacious master bedroom complete with a full bathroom, ample space for a TV area or office, and a terrace. 

There is a side entry from the front driveway to the back patio from the east side of the property  providing access to the yard. At the end of the garden, a two-bedroom cottage awaits, which includes a full kitchen, a living room, and a bathroom. This cottage also has a private patio/palapa for your guests to enjoy! 

The common area features a bodega, a pool with a filtration system and heater, a laundry area, and a garden. 

 The house is equipped with seven solar panels, a pressurization system, a water softener, and air conditioning, in addition to ceiling fans. It is being sold furnished. There is also a laundry room with a half bathroom for added convenience near the pool. 

 The houses have two updated plumbing systems that allow for the disposal of toilet paper, and each house includes its own 300-liter gas tank as well as separate CFE meters.

About this property
-------------------

Welcome to Casa Saasil, a low maintenance home in the charming seaside town of Chelem. This modern 3 Bedroom, 2 Bath Home is located within a secure Gated Community offering both privacy and peace of mind. Constructed just a few years ago, the residence blends contemporary architecture with the relaxed lifestyle of the Yucatán coast.

Step inside to find a bright, open concept layout designed for comfort and functionality. The spacious living and dining areas flow seamlessly into a well appointed kitchen, perfect for entertaining family and friends. Large windows invite natural light throughout the home, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

Outside, enjoy your own private pool, ideal for cooling off on sunny afternoons or hosting gatherings under the stars. Beyond your personal retreat, the community offers exceptional amenities including a shared pool, playground, and landscaped common areas perfect for families and social living.

As a resident, you’ll also enjoy exclusive access to a private beach club, where pristine sands and turquoise waters await. Whether you’re seeking a quiet morning walk along the shore or a lively afternoon with neighbors, the beach club provides the ultimate coastal escape.

\-- 3 spacious bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms

\-- Private pool plus access to community pool and playground

\-- Secure gated community with modern infrastructure

\-- Exclusive membership to a private beach club.

This property offers the best of both worlds: a tranquil retreat for seasonal living and a smart investment opportunity with strong rental appeal. Whether you’re envisioning a family getaway, a retirement haven, or a vacation rental, this Chelem home delivers comfort, security, and lifestyle in one of Yucatán’s most desirable coastal communities.

About this property
-------------------

TH Zyan is a brand new Townhouse located on the 2nd row in Chelem Puerto and a short walk away from the emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico. 

This stylish townhouse has Chukum finishes throughout and offers two good-sized bedrooms with two full bathrooms on the first floor. 

  

Upstairs, the social area awaits, integrating the living room, dining room, balcony and equipped kitchen with custom-made cabinets. A half bathroom completes this space. 

  

The third floor rooftop features a dipping pool (1.3m x 5.3m x 1.1 m deep), a BBQ area, full bathroom and amazing views of Chelem. 

  

TH Zyan is a well designed residence, full of natural light, and well designed to maximize the northern breezes coming off the coast.

About this property
-------------------

Welcome to Casa Amigoville — your island-style escape in the heart of Chelem, just steps from the Gulf of Mexico!

This 3 bedroom, 3.5 bath home sits on a fully walled double corner lot and offers incredible flexibility with two custom private guest suites—each with kitchenettes and access to a private rooftop terrace, where you will enjoy views of the Ocean!  Live in the main home and rent the top units or enjoy the entire property for yourself!   

Relax in your tropical courtyard featuring a sparkling pool, a poolside bar, complete with a custom gas barbecue, and an outdoor bathroom perfect for entertaining.

 Enjoy bright skylit interiors, solar panels, and secure, covered, gated off-street parking for two.  Guests will have unlimited connectivity with Fiber Optic Internet and a designated landline. 

Island vibes, income potential, and total privacy—all in a walkable in-town location. Contact me for details or to schedule a viewing!

Explore Merida
--------------

Merida, Yucatan is a vibrant historic city best known as the cultural capital of Latin America. Ancient Maya cities, stunning cenotes and majestic haciendas dot the countryside of the Yucatan. Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf Coast is just a short drive away. Most importantly, Merida is considered the safest city in the western hemisphere. Merida is now one of the top destinations for retirement, investment, and living.

About this property
-------------------

#### Luxury, Comfort, and Prime Location Await Your New Lifestyle!!

Overview 

Step into Villa Tortuga, a beautifully furnished contemporary villa just steps from the tranquil beaches of Chicxulub. With inviting outdoor living areas—including a rooftop lounge with a private soaking tub—this home is perfect for relaxing, entertaining, or generating rental income. Imagine waking up to warm coastal breezes, spending afternoons lounging by your private pool, and enjoying evenings under the stars on your rooftop terrace. Villa Tortuga offers an effortlessly luxurious lifestyle in a vibrant, welcoming community. 

Location 

Nestled in the heart of Chicxulub, Villa Tortuga is only a 2-minute stroll to the sun-kissed shoreline and a short walk to the lively town square. The villa’s prime location ensures you’re never far from the best the Yucatán coast has to offer: Progreso’s bustling Malecon and amenities are just a 5-minute drive away, while the historic city of Mérida—where tradition meets modern convenience—is only 30 minutes by car. 

Property Features 

*   Lot size: 726 sq ft (67.4 m²) 
    

*   Living space: 1,155 sq ft (107.3 m²) 
    

*   3 bedrooms, including a master suite with walk-in closet 
    

*   2 & 1/2 modern bathrooms 
    

*   Kitchen with custom wood cabinetry, granite countertops, and breakfast bar 
    

*   Open-plan living and dining rooms with high ceilings and cool tile floors 
    

*   Fully furnished for immediate move-in or rental income 
    

*   Private pool for refreshing dips on sunny days 
    

*   Rooftop covered sitting area with a private soaking tub
    

*   Barbecue area perfect for entertaining guests 
    

*   Covered carport for one vehicle 
    

*   Walled property for privacy and security 
    

*   7 solar panels for energy efficiency and reduced electric bills 
    

*   220V electrical system 
    

*   4 air conditioners & 2 ceiling fans for year-round comfort 
    

*   Pressure and well water systems 
    

*   Hot water (electric system) 
    

*   Wood doors, aluminum windows, and screens throughout 
    

*   Ample storage space 
    

*   High-speed Internet and TV connections 
    

Nearby Amenities 

*   Two-minute walk to the pristine beach for swimming and sunset strolls 
    

*   Easy walk to Chicxulub’s town square, home to local markets, restaurants, and community events 
    

*   Sports venue and the large public pier for outdoor recreation 
    

*   Five-minute drive to Progreso for supermarkets, including the new Walmart, hospitals, and family-friendly activities 
    

*   Short drive to Mérida, offering shopping, dining, museums, and vibrant cultural experiences 
    

Villa Tortuga isn’t just a home—it’s a gateway to the laid-back coastal lifestyle you’ve been dreaming of. Schedule your visit today and experience the perfect blend of relaxation, convenience, and adventure!

About this property
-------------------

Discover Villa Flamingo, a newly constructed villa located in the heart of Chicxulub Puerto. This stylish home offers the perfect blend of modern comfort and coastal living, just a two-minute walk from the beach and within walking distance to town. Enjoy a spacious covered rooftop sitting area with a private outdoor bathtub, ideal for relaxing or entertaining guests. 

Property Features 

*   3 bedrooms, including 1 ensuite 
    

*   3 bathrooms 
    

*   Construction: 1,155 sq ft / 107.34 m² 
    

*   Lot size: 725.81 sq ft / 67.43 m² 
    

*   Fully furnished 
    

*   Custom wood cabinets and granite countertops in kitchen 
    

*   Breakfast bar, living room, and dining room 
    

*   High ceilings and tile floors 
    

*   Master bedroom with walk-in closet 
    

*   Covered carport for 1 car 
    

*   Private pool and barbeque area 
    

*   Walled property for privacy 
    

*   Internet and TV connectivity 
    

*   7 solar panels, 220V electric, 4 air conditioners, 2 ceiling fans 
    

*   Pressure water, well water, hot water (electric) 
    

*   Aluminum windows and screens 
    

*   Storage space 
    

Location Highlights 

Chicxulub is a vibrant small town featuring a central square, sports venue, public pier, and a variety of restaurants and markets. Enjoy proximity to Progreso (just 5 minutes away) for major grocery stores, hospitals, the world-famous Malecon, and family-friendly activities. The historic city of Merida is only a 30-minute drive, offering everything from modern amenities to cultural attractions. 

This turnkey villa is perfect for year-round living or use as a rental property. Experience the best of Yucatán’s coastal lifestyle at Villa Flamingo.

Explore Merida
--------------

Merida, Yucatan is a vibrant historic city best known as the cultural capital of Latin America. Ancient Maya cities, stunning cenotes and majestic haciendas dot the countryside of the Yucatan. Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf Coast is just a short drive away. Most importantly, Merida is considered the safest city in the western hemisphere. Merida is now one of the top destinations for retirement, investment, and living.

About this property
-------------------

Casa Arrecifes is an adorable, brand-new residence located in a gated community in Chelem Puerto. This gated community includes a swimming pool, a clubhouse, and security.

This beautiful new home offers 3 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, a double-height open-concept room, kitchen with an island, a rear patio, and a private parking area. For additional entertainment and relaxation space there is a second floor terrace complete with a dipping pool, sundeck and outdoor kitchenette with chukum finishes. 

  

Casa Arrecifes is an incredible price perfect for a rental investment or your budget friendly beach gateway!

About this property
-------------------

Exceptional Beachfront Home on a Large Lot in Prime Chuburná Puerto 

This exceptional 2 Bedroom, 3 Bathroom Beacfront home is located in one of the most desirable beach areas of Chuburná Puerto, offering the perfect blend of comfort, sustainability, and coastal living. Set on a large lot and positioned on an entrada, the property provides privacy, security, and direct beach access. 

Beautifully remodeled, the home features an updated kitchen, custom wood doors and cabinetry, and a separate dining area ideal for entertaining. The thoughtfully designed layout includes a ground-floor primary bedroom with ensuite bathroom, offering convenience and ease of living, as well as an upper-level primary suite with its own private beachfront terrace, providing breathtaking ocean views and a tranquil retreat. 

Outdoor living is a highlight of this property, featuring a filtered swimming pool, lush gardens, a covered terrace, and both an outdoor gas grill area and separate charcoal grill area—perfect for relaxed beachside gatherings. 

The home is equipped with 12 solar panels and 3 battery backups for efficient and reliable power, along with off-street covered parking, beach-facing hurricane shutters, paper-friendly plumbing, and a private well for the pool with a backup water supply system. 

This turnkey beachfront property is ideal as a full-time residence, vacation home, or high-performing rental in one of Yucatán’s most sought-after coastal communities.

Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf Coast is just a short drive away. About this property
-------------------

Discover Casa Serenidad, an exquisite residence ideally situated within walking distance to the charming village of Chelem. This one-of-a-kind property offers a blend of modern upgrades and authentic Mexican architectural features, including iconic arched doorways and custom wood finishes throughout. 

Step outside to a fantastic pool area, complete with two expansive covered sitting spaces and lush, meticulously designed landscaping—perfect for relaxation or entertaining. Enjoy a seamless indoor-outdoor lifestyle with both an indoor kitchen and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen. The spacious open floor plan features high ceilings, abundant natural light from skylights, and elegant tile flooring. 

*   Construction: 2,066 sq ft / 191.99 m² 
    

*   Lot: 4,703 sq ft / 437 m² (Corner Lot) 
    

*   Bedrooms: 2 
    

*   Bathrooms: 2 
    

*   Walled and gated property for privacy 
    

*   Filter pool with built-in sitting stools 
    

*   Large laundry room 
    

*   Solid wood doors, custom wood shelving 
    

*   2 air conditioners, 7 ceiling fans 
    

*   Aluminum windows and screens, metal and PVC protectors 
    

*   220V electric, pressurized water system, well water 
    

*   Hot water with stationary gas tank 
    

*   Internet service available 
    

*   Outdoor barbeque area 
    

*   Fully furnished with tasteful décor 
    

Enjoy the best of both worlds—just a 3-minute walk to the beach, a short 20-minute drive to Progreso for major grocery stores, banks, a hospital, and the renowned Malecon boardwalk, and only 30 minutes to the historic city of Merida with world-class shopping, professional sports, and entertainment venues. 

Chelem is a quiet beach town known for its vibrant community events, diverse restaurants, convenient small grocery stores, and local medical services. This is the most sought-after beach destination in the area—an ideal place for full-time living or as a vacation retreat. 

Don’t miss this incredible opportunity to own a magical, move-in-ready home at the best value on the beach. Contact me today to schedule a private showing of Casa Serenidad!

Merida, Yucatan is a vibrant historic city best known as the cultural capital of Latin America. Ancient Maya cities, stunning cenotes and majestic haciendas dot the countryside of the Yucatan. Merida has its own international airport, first-class healthcare, modern amenities, timeless traditions, and rich history. Plus the Gulf Coast is just a short drive away. Most importantly, Merida is considered the safest city in the western hemisphere. Merida is now one of the top destinations for retirement, investment, and living.
